+# Lifetime delle fonti GET: metodo della verifica integrata
+
+Questo metodo precede le esecuzioni dell'incremento. Verifica il ponte
+[fonti della Serie](get-fonti-serie.md) con le API GET, WAL, primary ed EBR
+esistenti, FD nativi e worker distinti. Non introduce codice di prodotto,
+formati o un esecutore di compaction/rotazione.
+
+## Autorità e perimetro
+
+Ogni caso usa una sola chiave CLOSED iniziale, un controller ACTIVE
+ordinario, contesti privati e nessuno snapshot registrato. Le radici nuove
+sono pubblicate da lotti reali attraverso `pubblica-commit-serie`; le
+location correnti cambiano attraverso l'API pubblica del primary.
+Un nuovo PUT della stessa chiave ha un nuovo CSN: è una sostituzione della
+versione corrente, non la rilocazione fisica di una versione invariata.
+
+La fixture mantiene valide le mappe native fino alla chiusura. La decisione
+durabile del catalogo e la retention MVCC sono precondizioni del caller,
+non conclusioni di questa prova. I file temporanei sono rimossi soltanto
+nel cleanup esclusivo finale; il reclaim osservato chiude il FD e libera
+il ticket, senza attestare una rimozione durabile del segmento.
+
+L'obbligo `L ⊆ S(R)` vale a ogni acquisizione: il primo aggiornamento
+conserva CLOSED e ACTIVE insieme. La riduzione della directory avviene
+soltanto quando la vecchia location non è più nel primary corrente e
+l'unico vecchio reader ha già acquisito la capacità nel medesimo compito
+di lettura. Nessun nuovo lookup può allora copiare quella location.
+EBR protegge la capacità catturata, senza rendere risolvibile una mappa
+rimossa prima dell'acquisizione.
+
+## Casi e oracoli preregistrati
+
+Quattro test registrati, ciascuno nei formati v1/v2. Il primo impone
+serialmente l'ordine lookup/pubblicazione/acquisizione; gli altri tre
+usano un worker I/O distinto dal writer:
+
+1. Un GET copia il candidato CLOSED; il writer pubblica un superset ACTIVE.
+   L'acquisizione successiva risolve ancora il candidato e legge i byte
+   attesi dal file nativo.
+2. Un GET si ferma nell'hook della lettura nativa, dopo l'acquisizione.
+   Il writer prenota il ritiro prima delle modifiche logiche, pubblica
+   prima il superset, sostituisce la location corrente e poi pubblica
+   fonti ridotte. Il ritiro pubblicato non è acquisibile con il vecchio
+   pin attivo. Dopo lettura, copia e conclusione, il claim riesce,
+   una sola chiusura nativa avviene e il credito torna libero. Un GET
+   successivo verifica la nuova location ACTIVE e il valore atteso.
+3. Lo stesso ordine con una condizione tipizzata nell'hook nativo:
+   causa originale, output intatto e pin liberato prima del cleanup
+   esterno; poi il reclaim può completare.
+4. Lo stesso ordine con uscita non locale: cleanup interno del GET,
+   output intatto e pin liberato prima del cleanup esterno; poi reclaim.
+
+Gli oracoli confrontano input indipendenti, CSN/location del candidato,
+sentinelle del buffer, eventi I/O, stato FD, ticket, pin e crediti EBR.
+Le chiusure effettive sono osservate nel backend della fixture sotto
+mutex. Non si sostituiscono funzioni globali con worker in volo.
+Gate e timeout sono strumenti C4 per imporre l'interleaving, non attese
+aggiunte al prodotto; il worker I/O conserva il pin durante la syscall.
+Tutti i worker devono terminare prima di mutare contesti o chiudere FD
+dal controller. Timeout o mancato join falliscono il caso.
+
+## Esecuzioni e conservazione
+
+Sorgenti, registrazione ASDF e metodo sono congelati in un commit prima
+delle campagne. Compilazione senza warning, suite completa e controlli
+del repository passano attraverso `tools/record-command.lisp`/`make check`.
+La selezione ACTIVE preesistente resta invariata; questo incremento non
+richiede di ripetere la sua campagna di mutazione senza cambiamenti del
+prodotto o del driver. Una lettura indipendente verifica il protocollo e
+gli esiti grezzi; la CI verifica anche Linux.
+
+Output originali, errori eventualmente osservati, configurazioni e FASL
+privati sono conservati prima della pulizia. Report ed evidenze sono dati:
+lettura con `*read-eval* NIL` ed EOF, mai `LOAD`. La copia delle prove viene
+verificata integralmente prima della pubblicazione. Esiti e identità dei
+run saranno riportati nel catalogo della campagna dopo la verifica.
+
+Requisiti: REQ-IDX-001, REQ-WAL-006, REQ-CMP-007, REQ-AFF-001,
+REQ-AFF-008 e REQ-VAL-001. Questa verifica funzionale non qualifica
+prestazioni, zero heap, C1 o MC/DC globale.

+# Rendezvous dei worker nei test CBOR
+
+Metodo preregistrato prima della verifica della correzione. Il tentativo
+locale completo R1 della campagna [lifetime GET](get-lifetime.md) è fallito
+sull'overlap dei worker float; la CI della PR 13, run `38634044870`, è
+fallita su macOS sull'overlap dei worker tag. Ubuntu è riuscito. Le prove
+originali e gli esiti falliti restano distinti e conservati.
+
+Il rilascio simultaneo di due crediti del semaforo non impone allo
+scheduler di avviare entrambi i corpi prima che uno termini. Un intervallo
+non sovrapposto può quindi fallire il test dopo risultati corretti.
+La correzione riguarda soltanto le fixture float/tag, senza cambiare
+encoder, formati, conteggi di elementi, oracoli o API di prodotto.
+
+## Ordine controllato
+
+Ogni worker riusato registra il tempo reale iniziale, codifica il primo
+elemento e verifica risultato, immagine completa e contributo al sink.
+Registra poi il tempo del primo checkpoint, segnala `ready` e attende
+`go`. Il controller attende entrambi i checkpoint prima di consentire le
+rimanenti operazioni. Ogni onda mantiene semafori distinti; attese e join
+restano limitati e il cleanup libera le gate prima di arrestare i worker.
+
+Nessun worker può terminare il proprio corpo prima che l'altro abbia
+completato il primo elemento. Si verificano `start <= first <= finish`,
+`max(first) <= min(finish)`, durata positiva e overlap positivo. I tempi
+sono osservati, senza arrotondamenti, clamp o timestamp sintetici. Prima
+delle asserzioni temporali vengono stampati e scaricati gli intervalli,
+i checkpoint, i sink e l'overlap, così anche un nuovo fallimento conserva
+la diagnosi. Gli oracoli sui valori e sull'immutabilità restano invariati.
+
+La metrica è l'intervallo wall della **fixture** e comprende il rendezvous
+e i controlli. Dimostra l'interleaving imposto dei compiti; non misura
+latency del solo encoder, simultaneità CPU o scaling. I due helper hanno
+un solo chiamante ciascuno nei test e non sono usati dai benchmark.
+
+## Verifica
+
+Prima delle campagne viene congelato un nuovo commit di sorgenti e
+metodo. Una revisione indipendente verifica posizione del checkpoint,
+conteggi e cleanup. `make check` ricompila senza warning ed esegue tutte
+le suite, compresi i quattro casi lifetime v1/v2 invariati; la CI completa
+verifica poi Linux e macOS. Output originali, errori, configurazioni e
+cache private sono conservati; i dati sono letti con READ-EVAL NIL ed EOF,
+mai caricati come codice. Nessuna promozione di qualifica C1 o prestazionale.
+
+Requisiti: REQ-CBR-004, REQ-CBR-007, REQ-CON-005, REQ-AFF-004,
+REQ-AFF-008 e REQ-VAL-001.

+;;;; Audit indipendente: archivio e report come dati, FASL soltanto come bytes.
+(require :asdf)
+(require :sb-posix)
+(load "tools/evidence-storage.lisp")
+(let ((library (merge-pathnames "batch-sha.lisp" *load-truename*)))
+  (unless (equal "130f428551e1aa17a946c2614db5dc14adf9ae35309ec2b21c3be5b2d59be1da"
+                 (arcdocdb.evidence:file-sha256 library)) (error "Batch library SHA mismatch."))
+  (load library :verbose nil :print nil))
+(defpackage #:active.archive.audit (:use #:cl))
+(in-package #:active.archive.audit)
+(declaim (optimize (safety 3) (debug 3)))
+(defconstant +expanded-limit+ 134217728)
+(defvar *archive*)
+(defvar *fingerprint-cache* nil)
+(defparameter *batch-library* (merge-pathnames "batch-sha.lisp" *load-truename*))
+(defparameter *auditor-source* *load-truename*)
+(defparameter *audit-directory* (make-pathname :name nil :type nil :defaults *load-truename*))
+(defun require-check (predicate control &rest arguments)
+  (unless predicate (error (apply #'format nil control arguments)))
+  t)
+(defun read-data (path)
+  (arcdocdb.evidence:read-evidence path :max-expanded-bytes +expanded-limit+))
+(defun fingerprint (path)
+  (let ((cached (and *fingerprint-cache* (gethash (namestring (truename path)) *fingerprint-cache*))))
+    (if cached (list :bytes (getf cached :bytes) :sha256 (getf cached :sha256))
+        (list :bytes (arcdocdb.evidence:file-bytes path) :sha256 (arcdocdb.evidence:file-sha256 path)))))
+(defun leaf-p (value)
+  (and (stringp value) (plusp (length value))
+       (not (member value '("." "..") :test #'equal))
+       (not (find-if (lambda (character)
+                       (or (find character "/\\:*?[]") (< (char-code character) 32))) value))))
+(defun relative-p (value)
+  (and (stringp value) (plusp (length value))
+       (not (char= #\/ (char value 0)))
+       (every #'leaf-p (uiop:split-string value :separator "/"))))
+(defun files-in (root)
+  "Inventario indipendente, rifiuta symlink e file speciali a ogni livello."
+  (let ((files nil) (count 0))
+    (labels ((walk (directory depth)
+               (require-check (<= depth 64) "Profondità eccessiva: ~A." directory)
+               (dolist (entry (directory (make-pathname :name :wild :type :wild :defaults directory)
+                                         :resolve-symlinks nil))
+                 (require-check (<= (incf count) 100000) "Inventario oltre budget.")
+                 (let ((mode (sb-posix:stat-mode
+                              (sb-posix:lstat (string-right-trim "/" (namestring entry))))))
+                   (cond ((sb-posix:s-isdir mode) (walk entry (1+ depth)))
+                         ((sb-posix:s-isreg mode) (push entry files))
+                         (t (error "Symlink/file speciale: ~A." entry)))))))
+      (walk root 0))
+    (sort files #'string< :key #'namestring)))
+(defun relative-files (root)
+  (mapcar (lambda (path) (enough-namestring path root)) (files-in root)))
+(defun head ()
+  (string-trim '(#\Space #\Tab #\Newline #\Return)
+               (uiop:run-program '("git" "rev-parse" "HEAD") :output :string)))
+(defun directory-prefix-p (root path)
+  (uiop:string-prefix-p (namestring (uiop:ensure-directory-pathname root)) (namestring path)))
+(defun owned-output-path (output archive groups)
+  "Il parent deve già esistere: resolve prima di autorizzare qualsiasi write."
+  (let* ((path (merge-pathnames output (truename "./")))
+         (parent (truename (make-pathname :name nil :type nil :defaults path)))
+         (actual (merge-pathnames (file-namestring path) parent))
+         (temporary-directory (truename *audit-directory*)))
+    (require-check (and (leaf-p (file-namestring actual))
+                        (not (directory-prefix-p archive actual))
+                        (not (directory-prefix-p archive temporary-directory)))
+                   "Output/temp dentro archivio: ~A." output)
+    (dolist (group groups)
+      (let ((source (truename (uiop:ensure-directory-pathname (second group)))))
+        (require-check (and (not (directory-prefix-p source actual))
+                            (not (directory-prefix-p source temporary-directory)))
+                       "Output/temp dentro gruppo sorgente: ~A." (first group))))
+    (require-check (not (probe-file actual)) "Output già presente: ~A." actual)
+    actual))
+(defun sha-p (value)
+  (and (stringp value) (= 64 (length value))
+       (every (lambda (character) (or (char<= #\0 character #\9)
+                                     (char<= #\a character #\f))) value)))
+(defun expected-fingerprint (entry &optional expanded-p)
+  (list :bytes (getf entry (if expanded-p :uncompressed-bytes :bytes))
+        :sha256 (getf entry (if expanded-p :uncompressed-sha256 :sha256))))
+(defun cleanup-process (process)
+  (when process
+    (unwind-protect
+         (progn
+           (when (member (sb-ext:process-status process) '(:running :stopped))
+             (sb-ext:process-kill process sb-posix:sigkill))
+           (sb-ext:process-wait process))
+      (sb-ext:process-close process))))
+(defun expanded-fingerprint (path expected)
+  "gzip è espanso con limite prima di ogni write, mai interpretato come Lisp."
+  (require-check (typep expected `(integer 0 ,+expanded-limit+)) "Dimensione gzip invalida.")
+  (multiple-value-bind (fd name)
+      (sb-posix:mkstemp (namestring (merge-pathnames "decoded-XXXXXX" *audit-directory*)))
+    (let ((stream nil) (process nil) (temporary (pathname name)))
+      (unwind-protect
+           (progn
+             (setf stream (sb-sys:make-fd-stream fd :input t :output t
+                                               :element-type '(unsigned-byte 8) :auto-close t)
+                   fd nil)
+             (with-open-file (input path :direction :input :element-type '(unsigned-byte 8))
+               (setf process (sb-ext:run-program "gzip" '("-dc") :search t :wait nil
+                                                :input input :output :stream :error nil))
+               (let ((buffer (make-array 65536 :element-type '(unsigned-byte 8))) (total 0))
+                 (loop for count = (read-sequence buffer (sb-ext:process-output process)
+                                                  :end (min 65536 (1+ (- expected total))))
+                       until (zerop count) do
+                   (require-check (<= (+ total count) expected) "gzip supera i byte attesi: ~A." path)
+                   (write-sequence buffer stream :end count) (incf total count))
+                 (require-check (= total expected) "gzip incompleto: ~A." path))
+               (sb-ext:process-wait process)
+               (require-check (and (eq :exited (sb-ext:process-status process))
+                                   (eql 0 (sb-ext:process-exit-code process))) "gzip fallito: ~A." path))
+             (finish-output stream)
+             (fingerprint temporary))
+        (unwind-protect (cleanup-process process)
+          (unwind-protect
+               (if stream (close stream) (when fd (sb-posix:close fd)))
+            (when (probe-file temporary) (delete-file temporary))))))))
+
+(defun gzip-size (path)
+  "ISIZE del singolo gzip raccolto; l'espansione controlla davvero il limite."
+  (with-open-file (stream path :direction :input :element-type '(unsigned-byte 8))
+    (require-check (>= (file-length stream) 18) "gzip troppo corto: ~A." path)
+    (file-position stream (- (file-length stream) 4))
+    (loop for shift from 0 below 32 by 8 sum (ash (read-byte stream) shift))))
+(defun validate-entry (entry)
+  (let* ((relative (getf entry :path)) (source (getf entry :source))
+         (codec (getf entry :codec)) (path (merge-pathnames relative *archive*))
+         (gzip-p (equal "gz" (pathname-type path))) (expanded nil))
+    (require-check (and (relative-p relative) (stringp source)
+                        (typep (getf entry :bytes) '(integer 0 8388608))
+                        (sha-p (getf entry :sha256)) (member codec '(nil :gzip)))
+                   "Entry invalida: ~S." relative)
+    (require-check (equal (expected-fingerprint entry) (fingerprint path))
+                   "Copia/hash diversi: ~A." relative)
+    (require-check (<= (getf entry :bytes) (if gzip-p 8388608 1048576)) "Budget copia: ~A." relative)
+    (when codec
+      (setf expanded (expanded-fingerprint path (getf entry :uncompressed-bytes)))
+      (require-check (and (sha-p (getf entry :uncompressed-sha256))
+                          gzip-p (equal (expected-fingerprint entry t) expanded))
+                     "gzip espanso diverso: ~A." relative))
+    (when (and gzip-p (null codec))
+      (setf expanded (expanded-fingerprint path (gzip-size path))))
+    (let ((available (probe-file source)))
+      (when available
+        (require-check (sb-posix:s-isreg (sb-posix:stat-mode (sb-posix:lstat source)))
+                       "Sorgente speciale: ~A." source)
+        (require-check (equal (expected-fingerprint entry (eq codec :gzip)) (fingerprint source))
+                       "Sorgente diversa dalla copia: ~A." source)
+        (when (and gzip-p (null codec))
+          (require-check (equal expanded (expanded-fingerprint source (gzip-size source)))
+                         "gzip sorgente/copia espansi diversi: ~A." relative)))
+      (list :path relative :stored-bytes (getf entry :bytes) :codec codec
+            :expanded-fingerprint expanded :source-available (not (null available)) :verified t))))
+(defun stored-report (root relative)
+  (require-check (relative-p relative) "Path report invalido: ~S." relative)
+  (read-data (merge-pathnames relative root)))
+(defun check-process (process contract)
+  (let* ((relative (getf process :record-path)) (label (getf process :label))
+         (data (stored-report *archive* relative))
+         (expected (assoc label (getf contract :expected-processes) :test #'equal)))
+    (require-check (and expected (eql 1 (getf data :schema-version))
+                        (eq :command-verification (getf data :kind))
+                        (eq (second expected) (getf data :status))
+                        (eql (third expected) (getf data :exit-code))
+                        (eq (fourth expected) (getf data :source-consistency)))
+                   "Contratto comando diverso: ~A." label)
+    (dolist (key '(:command :status :exit-code :source-consistency))
+      (require-check (equal (getf process key) (getf data key)) "Metadati indice/report: ~A ~S." label key))
+    (list :label label :status (getf data :status) :exit-code (getf data :exit-code)
+          :source-consistency (getf data :source-consistency) :read-as-data t)))
+
+(defun parallel-map-four (function items)
+  "Ordered results, at most four workers; join all and propagate every failure."
+  (let* ((input (coerce items 'vector)) (size (length input)) (workers (min 4 size))
+         (results (make-array size)) (failures (make-array size :initial-element nil))
+         (threads nil) (launch-failure nil) (join-failures nil)
+         (defaults *default-pathname-defaults*) (package *package*)
+         (stdout *standard-output*) (stderr *error-output*) (archive *archive*) (audit-directory *audit-directory*) (cache *fingerprint-cache*))
+    (unwind-protect
+         (handler-case
+             (dotimes (worker workers)
+               (let ((start worker))
+                 (push (sb-thread:make-thread
+                        (lambda ()
+                          (let ((*default-pathname-defaults* defaults) (*package* package)
+                                (*standard-output* stdout) (*error-output* stderr)
+                                (*archive* archive) (*audit-directory* audit-directory) (*fingerprint-cache* cache))
+                            (loop for index from start below size by workers do
+                              (handler-case (setf (aref results index) (funcall function (aref input index)))
+                                (serious-condition (condition) (setf (aref failures index) condition))))))
+                        :name (format nil "publication-worker-~D" start)) threads)))
+           (serious-condition (condition) (setf launch-failure condition)))
+      (sb-sys:without-interrupts
+        (dolist (thread threads)
+          (handler-case (sb-thread:join-thread thread)
+            (serious-condition (condition) (push condition join-failures))))))
+    (let ((errors (loop for condition across failures for index from 0 when condition
+                        collect (list index (princ-to-string condition)))))
+      (when (or launch-failure join-failures errors)
+        (error "Parallel publication failed after joining all workers: launch=~A joins=~S entries=~S."
+               launch-failure (mapcar #'princ-to-string join-failures) errors)))
+    (coerce results 'list)))

+(defun metadata-storage ()
+  "Only the two metadata leaves may authorize their own descriptor payload."
+  (loop for leaf in '("archive-index.lisp" "catalogo.lisp")
+        for path = (merge-pathnames leaf *archive*) collect
+    (let* ((stored (fingerprint path))
+           (raw (progn
+                  (require-check (<= (getf stored :bytes) +expanded-limit+) "Metadata raw budget.")
+                  (with-standard-io-syntax
+                    (let ((*read-eval* nil) (eof (gensym)))
+                      (with-open-file (stream path :direction :input)
+                        (let* ((data (read stream nil eof)) (size (and (consp data) (list-length data))))
+                          (require-check (and size (evenp size) (eq eof (read stream nil eof)))
+                                         "Metadata requires one form and EOF.") data))))))
+           (compressed (eq :compressed-evidence (getf raw :kind)))
+           (payload (when compressed (getf raw :payload))) (payload-bytes nil))
+      (when compressed
+        (require-check (and (<= (getf stored :bytes) 1048576) (leaf-p payload)
+                            (equal payload (concatenate 'string leaf ".gz"))) "Metadata descriptor payload leaf.")
+        (read-data path) ; trusted reader validates exact descriptor shape, bytes, SHA and expansion.
+        (setf payload-bytes (fingerprint (merge-pathnames payload *archive*)))
+        (require-check (equal payload-bytes (list :bytes (getf raw :compressed-bytes)
+                                                 :sha256 (string-downcase (getf raw :compressed-sha256))))
+                       "Metadata payload differs from descriptor."))
+      (append (list :path leaf :raw-fingerprint stored)
+              (when compressed (list :descriptor raw :payload payload :payload-fingerprint payload-bytes))))))
+
+(defun entry-paths (entries)
+  (loop for entry in entries append
+    (progn
+      (require-check (and (relative-p (getf entry :path)) (stringp (getf entry :source))) "Invalid entry cache path.")
+      (cons (merge-pathnames (getf entry :path) *archive*)
+            (when (probe-file (getf entry :source)) (list (pathname (getf entry :source))))))))
+(defun entry-table (rows critical)
+  (let ((table (preflight.batch.sha:table rows)))
+    (dolist (path critical) (remhash (namestring (truename path)) table)) table))
+
+(defun audit (manifest-path archive-path contract-path output)
+  (let* ((*archive* (truename (uiop:ensure-directory-pathname archive-path)))
+         (manifest (read-data manifest-path)) (contract (read-data contract-path))
+         (manifest-before (fingerprint manifest-path)) (contract-before (fingerprint contract-path))
+         (reader-before (fingerprint "tools/evidence-storage.lisp"))
+         (auditor-before (fingerprint *auditor-source*))
+         (catalog-path (merge-pathnames "catalogo.lisp" *archive*)) (catalog-before (fingerprint catalog-path))
+         (output (owned-output-path output *archive* (getf manifest :groups)))
+         (index-path (merge-pathnames "archive-index.lisp" *archive*))
+         (index-before (fingerprint index-path)) (index (read-data index-path))
+         (entries (getf index :files)) (paths (mapcar (lambda (entry) (getf entry :path)) entries))
+         (initial-head (head)) (entry-results nil) (group-results nil) (process-results nil)
+         (native-results nil) (report-records nil) (initial-inventory (relative-files *archive*))
+         (metadata-before (metadata-storage))
+         (critical (list manifest-path contract-path index-path catalog-path *auditor-source* *batch-library* "tools/evidence-storage.lisp"))
+         (batch-library-before (fingerprint *batch-library*))
+         (snapshot-before (preflight.batch.sha:snapshot (entry-paths entries))))
+    (require-check (and (eql 1 (getf manifest :schema-version))
+                        (eql 1 (getf contract :schema-version))
+                        (eq :archive-audit-contract (getf contract :kind))
+                        (equal initial-head (getf contract :source-commit))
+                        (eql 1 (getf index :schema-version))
+                        (eq :original-command-archive (getf index :kind))
+                        (eq :read-without-result-inference (getf index :metadata-policy)))
+                   "Schema/freeze dell'archivio invalido.")
+    (require-check (= (length paths) (length (remove-duplicates paths :test #'equal))) "Entry duplicate.")
+    (require-check (equal (sort (copy-list initial-inventory) #'string<)
+                          (sort (append (copy-list paths) (list "archive-index.lisp" "catalogo.lisp")
+                                        (remove nil (mapcar (lambda (row) (getf row :payload)) metadata-before))) #'string<))
+                   "Inventario globale archivio diverso dall'indice.")
+    (let ((catalog (read-data catalog-path)))
+      (require-check (and (eql 1 (getf catalog :schema-version)) (eq :evidence-catalog (getf catalog :kind))
+                          (null (getf catalog :pending))
+                          (equal '("archive-index.lisp")
+                                 (mapcar (lambda (entry) (getf entry :artifact)) (getf catalog :entries))))
+                     "Catalogo invalido."))
+    (let ((*fingerprint-cache* (entry-table snapshot-before critical)))
+      (setf entry-results (reverse (parallel-map-four #'validate-entry entries))))
+    ;; Anche report figli/fixture non qualificati: vengono soltanto letti come
+    ;; dati e censiti. Status e kind non sono promossi a risultati di prodotto.
+    (dolist (entry entries)
+      (when (and (null (getf entry :codec))
+                 (equal "report.lisp" (file-namestring (pathname (getf entry :path)))))
+        (let ((data (stored-report *archive* (getf entry :path))))
+          (require-check (eql 1 (getf data :schema-version)) "Schema report figlio diverso: ~A." (getf entry :path))
+          (push (list :path (getf entry :path) :kind (getf data :kind)
+                      :status (getf data :status) :read-as-data t :result-inference nil) report-records))))
+    (let ((labels (mapcar #'first (getf manifest :groups))))
+      (require-check (and (= (length labels) (length (remove-duplicates labels :test #'equal)))
+                          (equal (sort (copy-list labels) #'string<)
+                                 (sort (copy-list (getf contract :expected-groups)) #'string<)))
+                     "Gruppi espliciti diversi dal contratto."))
+    (dolist (group (getf manifest :groups))
+      (destructuring-bind (label source-directory &optional process-p) group
+        (declare (ignore process-p))
+        (require-check (leaf-p label) "Label invalida.")
+        (let* ((base (truename (uiop:ensure-directory-pathname source-directory)))
+               (source-before (relative-files base))
+               (prefix (format nil "raw/~A/" label))
+               (selected (remove-if-not (lambda (entry) (uiop:string-prefix-p prefix (getf entry :path))) entries))
+               (source-expected (mapcar (lambda (entry)
+                                         (enough-namestring (pathname (getf entry :source)) base)) selected))
+               (stored (mapcar (lambda (entry) (subseq (getf entry :path) (length prefix))) selected))
+               (target (merge-pathnames prefix *archive*))
+               (fasl (count-if (lambda (name) (equal "fasl" (pathname-type (pathname name)))) source-before)))
+          (dolist (entry selected)
+            (let ((relative (enough-namestring (pathname (getf entry :source)) base)))
+              (require-check (and (relative-p relative)
+                                  (equal (getf entry :path)
+                                         (concatenate 'string prefix relative
+                                                      (if (eq :gzip (getf entry :codec)) ".gz" ""))))
+                             "Mapping sorgente/copia diverso: ~A." (getf entry :path))))
+          (require-check (equal (sort (copy-list source-before) #'string<) (sort source-expected #'string<))
+                         "Gruppo sorgente incompleto: ~A." label)
+          (require-check (equal (relative-files target) (sort stored #'string<))
+                         "Gruppo copia incompleto: ~A." label)
+          (when (member label (getf contract :required-fasl-groups) :test #'equal)
+            (require-check (plusp fasl) "FASL raw assenti: ~A." label))
+          (require-check (equal source-before (relative-files base)) "Inventario sorgente mutato: ~A." label)
+          (push (list :label label :files (length source-before) :raw-fasl fasl :exact-inventories t) group-results))))
+    (let ((processes (getf index :processes)))
+      (require-check (equal (sort (mapcar (lambda (item) (getf item :label)) processes) #'string<)
+                            (sort (mapcar #'first (getf contract :expected-processes)) #'string<))
+                     "Inventario comandi diverso.")
+      (dolist (process processes) (push (check-process process contract) process-results)))
+    (dolist (native (getf contract :native-reports))
+      (destructuring-bind (relative kind &optional status) native
+        (let ((data (stored-report *archive* relative)))
+          (require-check (and (eql 1 (getf data :schema-version)) (eq kind (getf data :kind))
+                              (or (null status) (eq status (getf data :status))))
+                         "Contratto report nativo diverso: ~A." relative)
+          (push (list :path relative :kind kind :status (getf data :status)
+                      :diagnostic (getf data :diagnostic) :read-as-data t) native-results))))
+    ;; Fresh full entry inventory: no first-pass hash may stand in for this pass.
+    (let* ((snapshot-after (preflight.batch.sha:snapshot (entry-paths entries)))
+           (*fingerprint-cache* (entry-table snapshot-after critical)))
+      (require-check (equal snapshot-before snapshot-after) "Entry source/copy byte inventory changed.")
+    (parallel-map-four (lambda (entry)
+      (require-check (equal (expected-fingerprint entry)
+                            (fingerprint (merge-pathnames (getf entry :path) *archive*)))
+                     "Copia mutata durante audit: ~A." (getf entry :path))
+      (let ((before (find (getf entry :path) entry-results :test #'equal
+                          :key (lambda (item) (getf item :path))))
+            (source (getf entry :source)))
+        (require-check (eql (getf before :source-available) (not (null (probe-file source))))
+                       "Disponibilità sorgente mutata: ~A." source)
+        (when (getf before :source-available)
+          (require-check (equal (expected-fingerprint entry (eq :gzip (getf entry :codec)))
+                                (fingerprint source)) "Sorgente mutata durante audit: ~A." source)))) entries))
+    (require-check (equal batch-library-before (fingerprint *batch-library*)) "Batch library changed during audit.")
+    (require-check (equal metadata-before (metadata-storage)) "Metadata descriptor/payload mutated during audit.")
+    (require-check (and (equal initial-head (head)) (equal index-before (fingerprint index-path))
+                        (equal catalog-before (fingerprint catalog-path))
+                        (equal manifest-before (fingerprint manifest-path))
+                        (equal contract-before (fingerprint contract-path))
+                        (equal reader-before (fingerprint "tools/evidence-storage.lisp"))
+                        (equal auditor-before (fingerprint *auditor-source*))
+                        (equal initial-inventory (relative-files *archive*))) "Archivio/HEAD mutato durante audit.")
+    (let ((report (list :schema-version 1 :kind :independent-active-archive-audit :status :ok
+                        :source-commit initial-head :reader-sha256 (arcdocdb.evidence:file-sha256 "tools/evidence-storage.lisp")
+                        :manifest-sha256 (arcdocdb.evidence:file-sha256 manifest-path)
+                        :archive-index-sha256 (getf index-before :sha256) :metadata-storage metadata-before
+                        :catalog-sha256 (getf catalog-before :sha256)
+                        :auditor-sha256 (getf auditor-before :sha256)
+                        :batch-library-sha256 (getf batch-library-before :sha256)
+                        :entry-byte-inventory snapshot-before :entry-inventory-passes 2 :entry-inventory-stable t
+                        :contract-sha256 (arcdocdb.evidence:file-sha256 contract-path)
+                        :file-count (length entries) :stored-bytes (reduce #'+ entries :key (lambda (entry) (getf entry :bytes)))
+                        :source-available-count (count-if (lambda (entry) (getf entry :source-available)) entry-results)
+                        :groups (reverse group-results) :processes (reverse process-results)
+                        :report-records (reverse report-records)
+                        :native-reports (reverse native-results) :entries (reverse entry-results)
+                        :limits '(:read-evidence-only :raw-fasl-as-bytes :complete-explicit-groups
+                                  :no-result-promotion :no-performance-or-mcdc-claim))))
+      (ensure-directories-exist output)
+      (with-open-file (stream output :direction :output :if-exists :error)
+        (let ((*print-readably* t)) (write report :stream stream :pretty t) (terpri stream)))
+      (format t "STATUS OK: ~D entry, ~D gruppi, ~D comandi, ~D report nativi.~%"
+              (length entries) (length group-results) (length process-results) (length native-results)))))
+
+(let ((arguments (uiop:command-line-arguments)))
+  (require-check (= 4 (length arguments)) "Uso: manifest archive audit-contract output.")
+  (apply #'audit arguments))

+;;;; Byte inventory only; same bounded hashlib literal as frozen Git8c, no evidence LOAD.
+(require :asdf)
+(require :sb-posix)
+(defpackage #:preflight.batch.sha (:use #:cl) (:export #:snapshot #:table))
+(in-package #:preflight.batch.sha)
+(declaim (optimize (safety 3) (debug 3)))
+(defparameter *workspace* (truename "./"))
+(defparameter *anchor* "8c0866711c50d047f87b9c484ce56d42a87ba19c")
+(defparameter *source* (merge-pathnames "tools/get-active-init-mutation.lisp" *workspace*))
+(defun git-line (&rest arguments)
+  (string-right-trim '(#\Newline #\Return)
+    (uiop:run-program (cons "git" arguments) :directory *workspace* :output :string :error-output :string)))
+(defparameter *source-blob* (git-line "rev-parse" (concatenate 'string *anchor* ":tools/get-active-init-mutation.lisp")))
+(defparameter *sha-code*
+  (progn
+    (unless (equal *source-blob* (git-line "hash-object" "--" (namestring *source*)))
+      (error "Batch hash source is not frozen Git8c blob."))
+    (let* ((text (uiop:read-file-string *source*)) (anchor "\"import os,sys,stat,hashlib")
+           (position (search anchor text)))
+      (unless (and (<= (length text) 1048576) position (not (search anchor text :start2 (1+ position))))
+        (error "Frozen hash literal absent/nonunique or source budget."))
+      (let ((*read-eval* nil) (*readtable* (copy-readtable nil)))
+        (multiple-value-bind (code end) (read-from-string text t nil :start position)
+          (declare (ignore end))
+          (unless (and (stringp code) (<= (length code) 8192)) (error "Frozen hash literal shape."))
+          code)))))
+(defun sha-p (value)
+  (and (stringp value) (= 64 (length value))
+       (every (lambda (c) (or (char<= #\0 c #\9) (char<= #\a c #\f))) value)))
+(defun checked-path (value)
+  (let* ((path (merge-pathnames value *workspace*)) (parts (pathname-directory path)))
+    (unless (and (uiop:absolute-pathname-p path) (not (wild-pathname-p path))
+                 (notany (lambda (p) (member p '(:up :back :wild :wild-inferiors))) parts))
+      (error "Unsupported inventory path: ~A." value))
+    (loop for n from 1 to (length parts) do
+      (let* ((parent (make-pathname :directory (subseq parts 0 n) :name nil :type nil :defaults path))
+             (name (string-right-trim "/" (namestring parent))))
+        (unless (sb-posix:s-isdir (sb-posix:stat-mode (sb-posix:lstat (if (equal name "") "/" name))))
+          (error "Symlink/special inventory ancestor: ~A." parent))))
+    (unless (sb-posix:s-isreg (sb-posix:stat-mode (sb-posix:lstat (namestring path))))
+      (error "Symlink/special inventory file: ~A." path))
+    (namestring (truename path))))
+(defun file-identity (path)
+  (let ((s (sb-posix:lstat path)))
+    (unless (and (sb-posix:s-isreg (sb-posix:stat-mode s)) (<= 0 (sb-posix:stat-size s) 16777216))
+      (error "Inventory file shape/16MiB budget: ~A." path))
+    (list (sb-posix:stat-dev s) (sb-posix:stat-ino s) (sb-posix:stat-mode s)
+          (sb-posix:stat-size s) (sb-posix:stat-mtime s) (sb-posix:stat-ctime s))))
+(defun argv-bytes (argv)
+  (loop for value in argv sum (1+ (length (sb-ext:string-to-octets value :external-format :utf-8)))))
+(defun snapshot (paths)
+  "Fresh sorted path/byte/SHA inventory; caller LOADs the trusted evidence oracle."
+  (unless (<= (length paths) 50000) (error "Inventory path count exceeds 50000."))
+  (let* ((files (sort (remove-duplicates (mapcar #'checked-path paths) :test #'equal) #'string<))
+         (before (mapcar #'file-identity files)) (pending (copy-list files)) (hashes nil)
+         (prefix (list "python3" "-c" *sha-code*)))
+    (loop while pending do
+      (let ((batch nil) (bytes (argv-bytes prefix)))
+        (loop while (and pending (< (length batch) 512)
+                         (<= (+ bytes (argv-bytes (list (first pending)))) 160000))
+              do (incf bytes (argv-bytes (list (first pending)))) (push (pop pending) batch))
+        (unless batch (error "Single inventory path exceeds argv budget."))
+        (setf batch (nreverse batch))
+        (multiple-value-bind (stdout stderr exit)
+            (uiop:run-program (append prefix batch) :output :string :error-output :string :ignore-error-status t)
+          (unless (eql 0 exit) (error "Batch SHA failed: ~A" stderr))
+          (let ((values (remove "" (uiop:split-string stdout :separator '(#\Newline)) :test #'equal)))
+            (unless (and (= (length batch) (length values)) (every #'sha-p values))
+              (error "Batch SHA cardinality/64hex mismatch."))
+            (setf hashes (nconc hashes values))))))
+    (unless (and (equal files (mapcar #'checked-path files)) (equal before (mapcar #'file-identity files)))
+      (error "Inventory path/identity drift during batch SHA."))
+    (let ((rows (loop for file in files for stat in before for hash in hashes
+                      collect (list :path file :bytes (fourth stat) :sha256 hash))))
+      (dolist (index (remove-duplicates (when rows (list 0 (floor (length rows) 2) (1- (length rows))))))
+        (let ((row (nth index rows)))
+          (unless (equal (getf row :sha256)
+                         (uiop:symbol-call :arcdocdb.evidence :file-sha256 (getf row :path)))
+            (error "Batch SHA/native oracle sample mismatch: ~A." (getf row :path)))))
+      rows)))
+(defun table (rows)
+  "No hashing: EQUAL table keyed by absolute canonical path, value is full row."
+  (let ((table (make-hash-table :test #'equal)))
+    (dolist (row rows)
+      (let ((path (getf row :path)))
+        (unless (and (stringp path) (uiop:absolute-pathname-p (pathname path))
+                     (typep (getf row :bytes) '(integer 0)) (sha-p (getf row :sha256))
+                     (not (gethash path table))) (error "Invalid/duplicate snapshot row."))
+        (setf (gethash path table) row)))
+    table))

+;;;; Raccolta di gruppi espliciti e completi, incluse cache FASL come soli dati.
+;;;; Derivato batch da collect-R2 SHA256 638945f457ad4c5aaec72a26ef2b708249ed84ae2964ac157af9daf243bbb9b0.
+;;;; Le copie normali sono accettate soltanto dopo snapshot SHA source/copy post-join.
+(require :asdf)
+(load "tools/evidence-storage.lisp")
+(defpackage #:resolver.collection (:use #:cl))
+(in-package #:resolver.collection)
+(declaim (optimize (safety 3) (debug 3)))
+(defparameter *collector-source* *load-truename*)
+(defconstant +plain-limit+ 1048576)
+(defconstant +gzip-limit+ 8388608)
+(defconstant +expanded-limit+ 134217728)
+(defvar *source-fingerprints* nil)
+(defvar *defer-normal-sha* nil)
+(defparameter *batch-library-sha256* "130f428551e1aa17a946c2614db5dc14adf9ae35309ec2b21c3be5b2d59be1da")
+
+(defun read-one (path)
+  (arcdocdb.evidence:read-evidence path))
+(defun save-new (path data)
+  (ensure-directories-exist path)
+  (with-open-file (stream path :direction :output :if-exists :error)
+    (let ((*print-readably* t)) (write data :stream stream :pretty t) (terpri stream))))
+(defun native-fingerprint (path)
+  (list :bytes (arcdocdb.evidence:file-bytes path) :sha256 (arcdocdb.evidence:file-sha256 path)))
+(defun fingerprint (path)
+  (let ((row (and *source-fingerprints*
+                  (gethash (namestring (merge-pathnames path)) *source-fingerprints*))))
+    (if row (list :bytes (getf row :bytes) :sha256 (getf row :sha256)) (native-fingerprint path))))
+(defun batch-snapshot (paths)
+  (uiop:symbol-call :preflight.batch.sha :snapshot paths))
+(defun snapshot-table (rows)
+  (uiop:symbol-call :preflight.batch.sha :table rows))
+(defun row-fingerprint (row)
+  (unless row (error "Path assente dallo snapshot batch."))
+  (list :bytes (getf row :bytes) :sha256 (getf row :sha256)))
+(defun leaf-p (value)
+  (and (stringp value) (plusp (length value))
+       (not (member value '("." "..") :test #'equal))
+       (not (find-if (lambda (c) (or (find c "/\\:*?[]") (< (char-code c) 32))) value))))
+(defun files-in (root)
+  (let ((files nil) (count 0))
+    (labels ((walk (directory depth)
+               (when (> depth 64) (error "Directory troppo profonda."))
+               (dolist (entry (directory (make-pathname :name :wild :type :wild :defaults directory)
+                                         :resolve-symlinks nil))
+                 (when (> (incf count) 100000) (error "Inventario troppo grande."))
+                 (let* ((name (string-right-trim "/" (namestring entry)))
+                        (mode (sb-posix:stat-mode (sb-posix:lstat name))))
+                   (cond ((sb-posix:s-isdir mode) (walk entry (1+ depth)))
+                         ((sb-posix:s-isreg mode) (push entry files))
+                         (t (error "File speciale o symlink: ~A." entry)))))))
+      (walk root 0))
+    (sort files #'string< :key #'namestring)))
+
+(defun copy-verified (source target root)
+  (let* ((before (fingerprint source)) (size (getf before :bytes))
+         (compressed (and (> size +plain-limit+) (not (equal "gz" (pathname-type source)))))
+         (actual (if compressed (pathname (concatenate 'string (namestring target) ".gz")) target)))
+    (unless (<= size +expanded-limit+) (error "Sorgente oltre budget: ~A." source))
+    (when (probe-file actual) (error "Destinazione esistente: ~A." actual))
+    (ensure-directories-exist actual)
+    (if compressed
+        (let ((decoded (pathname (concatenate 'string (namestring actual) ".decoded"))))
+          (uiop:run-program (list "gzip" "-n" "-9" "-c" (namestring source)) :output actual)
+          (unwind-protect
+               (progn
+                 (uiop:run-program (list "gzip" "-d" "-c" (namestring actual)) :output decoded)
+                 (unless (equal before (native-fingerprint decoded)) (error "Espansione diversa: ~A." source)))
+            (when (probe-file decoded) (delete-file decoded))))
+        (progn (uiop:copy-file source actual)
+               (unless (or *defer-normal-sha* (equal before (fingerprint actual)))
+                 (error "Copia diversa: ~A." source))))
+    (unless (or (and *defer-normal-sha* (not compressed))
+                (equal before (native-fingerprint source))) (error "Sorgente cambiata: ~A." source))
+    ;; For normal deferred files this is an expectation, not an accepted index entry.
+    (let ((stored (if (and *defer-normal-sha* (not compressed)) before (native-fingerprint actual))))
+      (unless (<= (getf stored :bytes) (if (equal "gz" (pathname-type actual)) +gzip-limit+ +plain-limit+))
+        (error "Artefatto oltre budget: ~A." actual))
+      (append (list :path (enough-namestring actual root) :source (namestring source)) stored
+              (when compressed (list :codec :gzip :uncompressed-bytes size
+                                     :uncompressed-sha256 (getf before :sha256)))))))
+
+(defun parallel-map-four (function items)
+  "Ordered results, at most four workers; join all and propagate every failure."
+  (let* ((input (coerce items 'vector)) (size (length input)) (workers (min 4 size))
+         (results (make-array size)) (failures (make-array size :initial-element nil))
+         (threads nil) (launch-failure nil) (join-failures nil)
+         (defaults *default-pathname-defaults*) (package *package*)
+         (stdout *standard-output*) (stderr *error-output*)
+         (source-fingerprints *source-fingerprints*) (defer-normal-sha *defer-normal-sha*))
+    (unwind-protect
+         (handler-case
+             (dotimes (worker workers)
+               (let ((start worker))
+                 (push (sb-thread:make-thread
+                        (lambda ()
+                          (let ((*default-pathname-defaults* defaults) (*package* package)
+                                (*standard-output* stdout) (*error-output* stderr)
+                                (*source-fingerprints* source-fingerprints) (*defer-normal-sha* defer-normal-sha))
+                            (loop for index from start below size by workers do
+                              (handler-case (setf (aref results index) (funcall function (aref input index)))
+                                (serious-condition (condition) (setf (aref failures index) condition))))))
+                        :name (format nil "publication-worker-~D" start)) threads)))
+           (serious-condition (condition) (setf launch-failure condition)))
+      (sb-sys:without-interrupts
+        (dolist (thread threads)
+          (handler-case (sb-thread:join-thread thread)
+            (serious-condition (condition) (push condition join-failures))))))
+    (let ((errors (loop for condition across failures for index from 0 when condition
+                        collect (list index (princ-to-string condition)))))
+      (when (or launch-failure join-failures errors)
+        (error "Parallel publication failed after joining all workers: launch=~A joins=~S entries=~S."
+               launch-failure (mapcar #'princ-to-string join-failures) errors)))
+    (coerce results 'list)))
+
+(defun collect (manifest-path destination)
+  (let* ((manifest (read-one manifest-path))
+         (root (merge-pathnames (uiop:ensure-directory-pathname destination) (truename "./")))
+         (manifest-before (native-fingerprint manifest-path))
+         (collector-before (native-fingerprint *collector-source*))
+         (library (merge-pathnames "batch-sha.lisp" *collector-source*))
+         (library-before (native-fingerprint library))
+         (files nil) (processes nil))
+    (unless (equal *batch-library-sha256* (getf library-before :sha256))
+      (error "Libreria batch diversa dalla fonte preregistrata."))
+    (load library :verbose nil :print nil)
+    (unless (and (eql 1 (getf manifest :schema-version)) (getf manifest :groups))
+      (error "Manifesto invalido."))
+    (when (probe-file root) (error "Archivio esistente: ~A." root))
+    (dolist (group (getf manifest :groups))
+      (destructuring-bind (label source-directory &optional process-p) group
+        (unless (leaf-p label) (error "Nome gruppo invalido."))
+        (let* ((base (truename (uiop:ensure-directory-pathname source-directory)))
+               (target-base (merge-pathnames (format nil "raw/~A/" label) root))
+               (before (files-in base))
+               (source-before (batch-snapshot before))
+               (*source-fingerprints* (snapshot-table source-before))
+               (*defer-normal-sha* t))
+          (unless (equal (mapcar #'namestring before)
+                         (mapcar (lambda (row) (getf row :path)) source-before))
+            (error "Snapshot sorgente non esatto: ~A." label))
+          (when (and process-p (> (getf (fingerprint (merge-pathnames "report.lisp" base)) :bytes)
+                                 +plain-limit+))
+            (error "Il produttore deve compattare il suo report prima della raccolta."))
+          (let* ((targets (mapcar (lambda (file) (merge-pathnames (enough-namestring file base) target-base)) before))
+                 (owned (loop for file in before for target in targets append
+                          (if (and (> (getf (fingerprint file) :bytes) +plain-limit+)
+                                   (not (equal "gz" (pathname-type file))))
+                              (list (concatenate 'string (namestring target) ".gz")
+                                    (concatenate 'string (namestring target) ".gz.decoded"))
+                              (list (namestring target))))))
+            (unless (= (length owned) (length (remove-duplicates owned :test #'equal)))
+              (error "Destinazioni/temp paralleli duplicati: ~A." label))
+            (dolist (name owned) (ensure-directories-exist name))
+            (let* ((pending (parallel-map-four (lambda (pair) (copy-verified (car pair) (cdr pair) root))
+                                              (mapcar #'cons before targets)))
+                   (copy-paths (sort (mapcar (lambda (entry) (merge-pathnames (getf entry :path) root)) pending)
+                                     #'string< :key #'namestring))
+                   (source-after (files-in base)))
+              (unless (and (equal before source-after)
+                           (equal copy-paths (files-in target-base)))
+                (error "Insieme sorgente/copie cambiato dopo join: ~A." label))
+              (let* ((copy-after (batch-snapshot copy-paths))
+                     (source-after-hashes (batch-snapshot source-after))
+                     (copy-table (snapshot-table copy-after)))
+                (unless (and (equal source-before source-after-hashes)
+                             (equal (mapcar #'namestring copy-paths)
+                                    (mapcar (lambda (row) (getf row :path)) copy-after)))
+                  (error "Sorgenti mutate o snapshot copie incompleto: ~A." label))
+                (dolist (entry pending)
+                  (let* ((source (gethash (getf entry :source) *source-fingerprints*))
+                         (copy (gethash (namestring (merge-pathnames (getf entry :path) root)) copy-table))
+                         (compressed (eq :gzip (getf entry :codec))))
+                    (unless (and (equal (row-fingerprint copy) (list :bytes (getf entry :bytes)
+                                                                   :sha256 (getf entry :sha256)))
+                                 (equal (row-fingerprint source)
+                                        (list :bytes (getf entry (if compressed :uncompressed-bytes :bytes))
+                                              :sha256 (getf entry (if compressed :uncompressed-sha256 :sha256)))))
+                      (error "Copia batch diversa dalle aspettative originarie: ~A." (getf entry :source)))))
+                (unless (and (equal before (files-in base)) (equal copy-paths (files-in target-base)))
+                  (error "Inventario sorgente/copie mutato durante hash batch: ~A." label))
+                ;; Only fully verified groups can enter the future archive index.
+                (setf files (nconc pending files)))))
+          (when process-p
+            (let* ((source (merge-pathnames "report.lisp" base))
+                   (target (merge-pathnames "report.lisp" target-base)) (data (read-one source)))
+              (unless (and (eql 1 (getf data :schema-version)) (eq :command-verification (getf data :kind))
+                           (member (getf data :status) '(:ok :failed :source-changed))
+                           (equalp data (read-one target)))
+                (error "Record incompleto o diverso: ~A." source))
+              (push (list :label label :record-path (enough-namestring target root)
+                          :command (getf data :command) :status (getf data :status)
+                          :exit-code (getf data :exit-code) :source-consistency (getf data :source-consistency))
+                    processes))))))
+    ;; Outside group bindings all original per-file checks remain active, as in append.
+    (push (copy-verified (truename manifest-path) (merge-pathnames "collection-manifest.lisp" root) root) files)
+    (push (copy-verified (truename *collector-source*) (merge-pathnames "collection-source.txt" root) root) files)
+    (dolist (item (getf manifest :files))
+      (destructuring-bind (label source) item
+        (unless (leaf-p label) (error "Nome file invalido."))
+        (push (copy-verified (truename source) (merge-pathnames label root) root) files)))
+    (unless (and (equal manifest-before (native-fingerprint manifest-path))
+                 (equal collector-before (native-fingerprint *collector-source*))
+                 (equal library-before (native-fingerprint library)))
+      (error "Manifesto, collector o libreria mutati prima dell'indice finale."))
+    (let ((paths (mapcar (lambda (entry) (getf entry :path)) files)))
+      (unless (= (length paths) (length (remove-duplicates paths :test #'equal))) (error "Path duplicato.")))
+    (save-new (merge-pathnames "archive-index.lisp" root)
+              (list :schema-version 1 :kind :original-command-archive
+                    :metadata-policy :read-without-result-inference :processes (reverse processes)
+                    :files (sort (copy-list files) #'string< :key (lambda (entry) (getf entry :path)))
+                    :limits '(:complete-explicit-groups :raw-fasl-preserved-as-data
+                              :source-and-copy-sha256 :lossless-gzip-for-large-raw :no-result-promotion)))

+                                :artifact-schema-version 1 :artifact-kind :original-command-archive))))
+    (format t "~D file conservati, ~D comandi.~%" (length files) (length processes))))
+
+(defun append-group (destination label source-directory)
+  "Aggiunge un gruppo completo; riscrive soltanto l'indice derivato, mai originali."
+  (unless (leaf-p label) (error "Nome gruppo invalido."))
+  (let* ((root (truename (uiop:ensure-directory-pathname destination)))
+         (index-path (merge-pathnames "archive-index.lisp" root)) (index (read-one index-path))
+         (base (truename (uiop:ensure-directory-pathname source-directory)))
+         (target-base (merge-pathnames (format nil "raw/~A/" label) root))
+         (source (merge-pathnames "report.lisp" base)) (data (read-one source))
+         (before (files-in base)) (files nil))
+    (when (> (arcdocdb.evidence:file-bytes source) +plain-limit+)
+      (error "Il produttore deve compattare il suo report prima dell'aggiunta."))
+    (when (probe-file target-base) (error "Gruppo esistente."))
+    (unless (and (eq :original-command-archive (getf index :kind))
+                 (eq :command-verification (getf data :kind))
+                 (member (getf data :status) '(:ok :failed :source-changed)))
+      (error "Archivio o comando incompleto."))
+    (dolist (file before)
+      (push (copy-verified file (merge-pathnames (enough-namestring file base) target-base) root) files))
+    (unless (and (equal before (files-in base))
+                 (equalp data (read-one (merge-pathnames "report.lisp" target-base))))
+      (error "Sorgente/record diverso."))
+    (setf (getf index :files) (append (getf index :files) (nreverse files))
+          (getf index :processes)
+          (append (getf index :processes)
+                  (list (list :label label :record-path (enough-namestring
+                                                        (merge-pathnames "report.lisp" target-base) root)
+                              :command (getf data :command) :status (getf data :status)
+                              :exit-code (getf data :exit-code) :source-consistency (getf data :source-consistency)))))
+    (with-open-file (stream index-path :direction :output :if-exists :supersede)
+      (let ((*print-readably* t)) (write index :stream stream :pretty t) (terpri stream)))
+    (format t "Gruppo ~A aggiunto, ~D file.~%" label (length files))))
+
+(defun directory-prefix-p (root path)
+  (uiop:string-prefix-p (namestring (uiop:ensure-directory-pathname root)) (namestring path)))
+
+(defun byte-inventory (root)
+  "Inventario ordinato di path e bytes originali; non interpreta i file."
+  (loop for file in (files-in root)
+        collect (append (list :path (enough-namestring file root)) (fingerprint file))))
+
+(defun size-inventory (root)
+  "I file già archiviati sono censiti per path e dimensione, senza nuovo SHA.
+L'audit finale controlla separatamente tutti i loro hash in due passaggi."
+  (loop for file in (files-in root)
+        collect (list :path (enough-namestring file root)
+                      :bytes (arcdocdb.evidence:file-bytes file))))
+
+(defun append-files (destination label source-directory)
+  "Aggiunge solo bytes di un gruppo completo, senza inferire report o risultati.
+Le copie parziali e gli indici preparatori restano disponibili in caso di errore."
+  (unless (leaf-p label) (error "Nome gruppo invalido."))
+  (let* ((root (truename (uiop:ensure-directory-pathname destination)))
+         (base (truename (uiop:ensure-directory-pathname source-directory)))
+         (index-path (merge-pathnames "archive-index.lisp" root))
+         (index (read-one index-path))
+         (prefix (format nil "raw/~A/" label))
+         (target-base (merge-pathnames prefix root))
+         (helper-base (uiop:pathname-directory-pathname (truename *collector-source*)))
+         (backup (merge-pathnames (format nil "append-~A-index-before.lisp.txt" label) helper-base))
+         (candidate (merge-pathnames (format nil "append-~A-index-next.lisp.txt" label) helper-base))
+         (collector-before (fingerprint *collector-source*))
+         (index-before (fingerprint index-path))
+         (source-before nil) (archive-before nil) (expected-archive nil) (index-next nil) (files nil))
+    (unless (and (eql 1 (getf index :schema-version))
+                 (eq :original-command-archive (getf index :kind))
+                 (eq :read-without-result-inference (getf index :metadata-policy))
+                 (listp (getf index :files)) (getf index :files))
+      (error "Indice archivio invalido."))
+    (when (or (directory-prefix-p root base) (directory-prefix-p base root)
+              (directory-prefix-p root helper-base) (directory-prefix-p base helper-base))
+      (error "Archivio, sorgente e helper devono avere perimetri separati."))
+    (when (or (probe-file target-base)
+              (some (lambda (entry) (uiop:string-prefix-p prefix (getf entry :path)))
+                    (getf index :files))
+              (find label (getf index :processes) :key (lambda (entry) (getf entry :label)) :test #'equal))
+      (error "Gruppo esistente: ~A." label))
+    (when (or (probe-file backup) (probe-file candidate))
+      (error "Prove append esistenti: ~A." label))
+    (setf source-before (byte-inventory base) archive-before (size-inventory root))
+    (unless source-before (error "Gruppo sorgente vuoto: ~A." base))
+    ;; Conserva l'indice precedente fuori dai gruppi e dall'archivio.
+    (uiop:copy-file index-path backup)
+    (unless (equal index-before (fingerprint backup)) (error "Backup indice diverso."))
+    (dolist (entry source-before)
+      (let* ((relative (getf entry :path))
+             (copy (copy-verified (merge-pathnames relative base)
+                                  (merge-pathnames relative target-base) root))
+             (compressed (eq :gzip (getf copy :codec))))
+        (unless (and (= (getf entry :bytes)
+                        (getf copy (if compressed :uncompressed-bytes :bytes)))
+                     (equal (getf entry :sha256)
+                            (getf copy (if compressed :uncompressed-sha256 :sha256))))
+          (error "Copia diversa dall'inventario sorgente iniziale: ~A." relative))
+        (push copy files)))
+    (setf files (sort files #'string< :key (lambda (entry) (getf entry :path))))
+    (unless (and (equal source-before (byte-inventory base))
+                 (equal collector-before (fingerprint *collector-source*)))
+      (error "Gruppo sorgente o collector mutato durante append."))
+    (let* ((new-inventory (mapcar (lambda (entry)
+                                   (list :path (getf entry :path) :bytes (getf entry :bytes))) files))
+           (all-paths (append (mapcar (lambda (entry) (getf entry :path)) (getf index :files))
+                              (mapcar (lambda (entry) (getf entry :path)) files))))
+      (setf expected-archive (sort (append (copy-list archive-before) new-inventory)
+                                  #'string< :key (lambda (entry) (getf entry :path))))
+      (unless (= (length all-paths) (length (remove-duplicates all-paths :test #'equal)))
+        (error "Path indice duplicato."))
+      (unless (equal expected-archive (size-inventory root))
+        (error "Archivio precedente o nuove copie mutati durante append.")))
+    ;; Il gruppo è generico: :processes e tutti gli originali rimangono identici.
+    (setf (getf index :files) (sort (append (copy-list (getf index :files)) files)
+                                  #'string< :key (lambda (entry) (getf entry :path))))
+    (save-new candidate index)
+    (setf index-next (fingerprint candidate))
+    (unless (and (equalp index (read-one candidate))
+                 (equal index-before (fingerprint index-path))
+                 (equal index-before (fingerprint backup))
+                 (equal source-before (byte-inventory base))
+                 (equal collector-before (fingerprint *collector-source*)))
+      (error "Indice preparato o sorgenti mutati prima della pubblicazione."))
+    ;; Rinomina atomica sullo stesso filesystem: un errore conserva il candidato.
+    (sb-posix:rename (namestring candidate) (namestring index-path))
+    (setf expected-archive
+          (mapcar (lambda (entry)
+                    (if (equal "archive-index.lisp" (getf entry :path))
+                        (list :path "archive-index.lisp" :bytes (getf index-next :bytes)) entry)) expected-archive))
+    (unless (and (equalp index (read-one index-path))
+                 (equal index-next (fingerprint index-path))
+                 (equal expected-archive (size-inventory root))
+                 (equal source-before (byte-inventory base))
+                 (equal collector-before (fingerprint *collector-source*))
+                 (equal index-before (fingerprint backup)))
+      (error "Indice pubblicato, copie o sorgenti diversi dopo append."))
+    (format t "Gruppo raw ~A aggiunto, ~D file; nessuna inferenza di risultato.~%" label (length files))
+    (format t "Limite append: file preesistenti controllati per path/dimensione; SHA completi nell'audit finale.~%")))
+
+(require :sb-posix)
+(let ((arguments (uiop:command-line-arguments)))
+  (cond ((= 2 (length arguments)) (collect (first arguments) (second arguments)))
+        ((and (= 4 (length arguments)) (equal "--append" (first arguments)))
+         (append-group (second arguments) (third arguments) (fourth arguments)))
+        ((and (= 4 (length arguments)) (equal "--append-files" (first arguments)))
+         (append-files (second arguments) (third arguments) (fourth arguments)))
+        (t (error "Uso: manifest destinazione oppure --append/--append-files destinazione label source-directory."))))
