+        (when (getf before :source-available)
+          (require-check (equal (expected-fingerprint entry (eq :gzip (getf entry :codec)))
+                                (fingerprint source)) "Sorgente mutata durante audit: ~A." source)))) entries))
+    (require-check (equal batch-library-before (fingerprint *batch-library*)) "Batch library changed during audit.")
+    (require-check (equal metadata-before (metadata-storage)) "Metadata descriptor/payload mutated during audit.")
+    (require-check (and (equal initial-head (head)) (equal index-before (fingerprint index-path))
+                        (equal catalog-before (fingerprint catalog-path))
+                        (equal manifest-before (fingerprint manifest-path))
+                        (equal contract-before (fingerprint contract-path))
+                        (equal reader-before (fingerprint "tools/evidence-storage.lisp"))
+                        (equal auditor-before (fingerprint *auditor-source*))
+                        (equal initial-inventory (relative-files *archive*))) "Archivio/HEAD mutato durante audit.")
+    (let ((report (list :schema-version 1 :kind :independent-active-archive-audit :status :ok
+                        :source-commit initial-head :reader-sha256 (arcdocdb.evidence:file-sha256 "tools/evidence-storage.lisp")
+                        :manifest-sha256 (arcdocdb.evidence:file-sha256 manifest-path)
+                        :archive-index-sha256 (getf index-before :sha256) :metadata-storage metadata-before
+                        :catalog-sha256 (getf catalog-before :sha256)
+                        :auditor-sha256 (getf auditor-before :sha256)
+                        :batch-library-sha256 (getf batch-library-before :sha256)
+                        :entry-byte-inventory snapshot-before :entry-inventory-passes 2 :entry-inventory-stable t
+                        :contract-sha256 (arcdocdb.evidence:file-sha256 contract-path)
+                        :file-count (length entries) :stored-bytes (reduce #'+ entries :key (lambda (entry) (getf entry :bytes)))
+                        :source-available-count (count-if (lambda (entry) (getf entry :source-available)) entry-results)

+                        :report-records (reverse report-records)
+                        :native-reports (reverse native-results) :entries (reverse entry-results)

+      (ensure-directories-exist output)
+      (with-open-file (stream output :direction :output :if-exists :error)
+        (let ((*print-readably* t)) (write report :stream stream :pretty t) (terpri stream)))
+      (format t "STATUS OK: ~D entry, ~D gruppi, ~D comandi, ~D report nativi.~%"
+              (length entries) (length group-results) (length process-results) (length native-results)))))

+;;;; Byte inventory only; same bounded hashlib literal as frozen Git8c, no evidence LOAD.
+(require :asdf)
+(require :sb-posix)
+(defpackage #:preflight.batch.sha (:use #:cl) (:export #:snapshot #:table))
+(in-package #:preflight.batch.sha)
+(declaim (optimize (safety 3) (debug 3)))
+(defparameter *workspace* (truename "./"))
+(defparameter *anchor* "8c0866711c50d047f87b9c484ce56d42a87ba19c")
+(defparameter *source* (merge-pathnames "tools/get-active-init-mutation.lisp" *workspace*))
+(defun git-line (&rest arguments)
+  (string-right-trim '(#\Newline #\Return)
+    (uiop:run-program (cons "git" arguments) :directory *workspace* :output :string :error-output :string)))
+(defparameter *source-blob* (git-line "rev-parse" (concatenate 'string *anchor* ":tools/get-active-init-mutation.lisp")))
+(defparameter *sha-code*
+  (progn
+    (unless (equal *source-blob* (git-line "hash-object" "--" (namestring *source*)))
+      (error "Batch hash source is not frozen Git8c blob."))
+    (let* ((text (uiop:read-file-string *source*)) (anchor "\"import os,sys,stat,hashlib")
+           (position (search anchor text)))
+      (unless (and (<= (length text) 1048576) position (not (search anchor text :start2 (1+ position))))
+        (error "Frozen hash literal absent/nonunique or source budget."))
+      (let ((*read-eval* nil) (*readtable* (copy-readtable nil)))
+        (multiple-value-bind (code end) (read-from-string text t nil :start position)
+          (declare (ignore end))
+          (unless (and (stringp code) (<= (length code) 8192)) (error "Frozen hash literal shape."))
+          code)))))
+(defun sha-p (value)
+  (and (stringp value) (= 64 (length value))
+       (every (lambda (c) (or (char<= #\0 c #\9) (char<= #\a c #\f))) value)))
+(defun checked-path (value)
+  (let* ((path (merge-pathnames value *workspace*)) (parts (pathname-directory path)))
+    (unless (and (uiop:absolute-pathname-p path) (not (wild-pathname-p path))
+                 (notany (lambda (p) (member p '(:up :back :wild :wild-inferiors))) parts))
+      (error "Unsupported inventory path: ~A." value))
+    (loop for n from 1 to (length parts) do
+      (let* ((parent (make-pathname :directory (subseq parts 0 n) :name nil :type nil :defaults path))
+             (name (string-right-trim "/" (namestring parent))))
+        (unless (sb-posix:s-isdir (sb-posix:stat-mode (sb-posix:lstat (if (equal name "") "/" name))))
+          (error "Symlink/special inventory ancestor: ~A." parent))))
+    (unless (sb-posix:s-isreg (sb-posix:stat-mode (sb-posix:lstat (namestring path))))
+      (error "Symlink/special inventory file: ~A." path))
+    (namestring (truename path))))
+(defun file-identity (path)
+  (let ((s (sb-posix:lstat path)))
+    (unless (and (sb-posix:s-isreg (sb-posix:stat-mode s)) (<= 0 (sb-posix:stat-size s) 16777216))
+      (error "Inventory file shape/16MiB budget: ~A." path))
+    (list (sb-posix:stat-dev s) (sb-posix:stat-ino s) (sb-posix:stat-mode s)
+          (sb-posix:stat-size s) (sb-posix:stat-mtime s) (sb-posix:stat-ctime s))))
+(defun argv-bytes (argv)
+  (loop for value in argv sum (1+ (length (sb-ext:string-to-octets value :external-format :utf-8)))))
+(defun snapshot (paths)
+  "Fresh sorted path/byte/SHA inventory; caller LOADs the trusted evidence oracle."
+  (unless (<= (length paths) 50000) (error "Inventory path count exceeds 50000."))
+  (let* ((files (sort (remove-duplicates (mapcar #'checked-path paths) :test #'equal) #'string<))
+         (before (mapcar #'file-identity files)) (pending (copy-list files)) (hashes nil)
+         (prefix (list "python3" "-c" *sha-code*)))
+    (loop while pending do
+      (let ((batch nil) (bytes (argv-bytes prefix)))
+        (loop while (and pending (< (length batch) 512)
+                         (<= (+ bytes (argv-bytes (list (first pending)))) 160000))
+              do (incf bytes (argv-bytes (list (first pending)))) (push (pop pending) batch))
+        (unless batch (error "Single inventory path exceeds argv budget."))
+        (setf batch (nreverse batch))
+        (multiple-value-bind (stdout stderr exit)
+            (uiop:run-program (append prefix batch) :output :string :error-output :string :ignore-error-status t)
+          (unless (eql 0 exit) (error "Batch SHA failed: ~A" stderr))
+          (let ((values (remove "" (uiop:split-string stdout :separator '(#\Newline)) :test #'equal)))
+            (unless (and (= (length batch) (length values)) (every #'sha-p values))
+              (error "Batch SHA cardinality/64hex mismatch."))
+            (setf hashes (nconc hashes values))))))
+    (unless (and (equal files (mapcar #'checked-path files)) (equal before (mapcar #'file-identity files)))
+      (error "Inventory path/identity drift during batch SHA."))
+    (let ((rows (loop for file in files for stat in before for hash in hashes
+                      collect (list :path file :bytes (fourth stat) :sha256 hash))))
+      (dolist (index (remove-duplicates (when rows (list 0 (floor (length rows) 2) (1- (length rows))))))
+        (let ((row (nth index rows)))
+          (unless (equal (getf row :sha256)
+                         (uiop:symbol-call :arcdocdb.evidence :file-sha256 (getf row :path)))
+            (error "Batch SHA/native oracle sample mismatch: ~A." (getf row :path)))))
+      rows)))
+(defun table (rows)
+  "No hashing: EQUAL table keyed by absolute canonical path, value is full row."
+  (let ((table (make-hash-table :test #'equal)))
+    (dolist (row rows)
+      (let ((path (getf row :path)))
+        (unless (and (stringp path) (uiop:absolute-pathname-p (pathname path))
+                     (typep (getf row :bytes) '(integer 0)) (sha-p (getf row :sha256))
+                     (not (gethash path table))) (error "Invalid/duplicate snapshot row."))
+        (setf (gethash path table) row)))
+    table))

+;;;; Raccolta di gruppi espliciti e completi, incluse cache FASL come soli dati.
+;;;; Derivato batch da collect-R2 SHA256 638945f457ad4c5aaec72a26ef2b708249ed84ae2964ac157af9daf243bbb9b0.
+;;;; Le copie normali sono accettate soltanto dopo snapshot SHA source/copy post-join.
+(require :asdf)
+(load "tools/evidence-storage.lisp")
+(defpackage #:resolver.collection (:use #:cl))
+(in-package #:resolver.collection)
+(declaim (optimize (safety 3) (debug 3)))
+(defparameter *collector-source* *load-truename*)
+(defconstant +plain-limit+ 1048576)
+(defconstant +gzip-limit+ 8388608)
+(defconstant +expanded-limit+ 134217728)
+(defvar *source-fingerprints* nil)
+(defvar *defer-normal-sha* nil)
+(defparameter *batch-library-sha256* "130f428551e1aa17a946c2614db5dc14adf9ae35309ec2b21c3be5b2d59be1da")
+
+(defun read-one (path)
+  (arcdocdb.evidence:read-evidence path))
+(defun save-new (path data)
+  (ensure-directories-exist path)
+  (with-open-file (stream path :direction :output :if-exists :error)
+    (let ((*print-readably* t)) (write data :stream stream :pretty t) (terpri stream))))
+(defun native-fingerprint (path)
+  (list :bytes (arcdocdb.evidence:file-bytes path) :sha256 (arcdocdb.evidence:file-sha256 path)))
+(defun fingerprint (path)
+  (let ((row (and *source-fingerprints*
+                  (gethash (namestring (merge-pathnames path)) *source-fingerprints*))))
+    (if row (list :bytes (getf row :bytes) :sha256 (getf row :sha256)) (native-fingerprint path))))
+(defun batch-snapshot (paths)
+  (uiop:symbol-call :preflight.batch.sha :snapshot paths))
+(defun snapshot-table (rows)
+  (uiop:symbol-call :preflight.batch.sha :table rows))
+(defun row-fingerprint (row)
+  (unless row (error "Path assente dallo snapshot batch."))
+  (list :bytes (getf row :bytes) :sha256 (getf row :sha256)))
+(defun leaf-p (value)
+  (and (stringp value) (plusp (length value))
+       (not (member value '("." "..") :test #'equal))
+       (not (find-if (lambda (c) (or (find c "/\\:*?[]") (< (char-code c) 32))) value))))
+(defun files-in (root)
+  (let ((files nil) (count 0))
+    (labels ((walk (directory depth)
+               (when (> depth 64) (error "Directory troppo profonda."))
+               (dolist (entry (directory (make-pathname :name :wild :type :wild :defaults directory)
+                                         :resolve-symlinks nil))
+                 (when (> (incf count) 100000) (error "Inventario troppo grande."))
+                 (let* ((name (string-right-trim "/" (namestring entry)))
+                        (mode (sb-posix:stat-mode (sb-posix:lstat name))))
+                   (cond ((sb-posix:s-isdir mode) (walk entry (1+ depth)))
+                         ((sb-posix:s-isreg mode) (push entry files))
+                         (t (error "File speciale o symlink: ~A." entry)))))))
+      (walk root 0))
+    (sort files #'string< :key #'namestring)))
+
+(defun copy-verified (source target root)
+  (let* ((before (fingerprint source)) (size (getf before :bytes))
+         (compressed (and (> size +plain-limit+) (not (equal "gz" (pathname-type source)))))
+         (actual (if compressed (pathname (concatenate 'string (namestring target) ".gz")) target)))
+    (unless (<= size +expanded-limit+) (error "Sorgente oltre budget: ~A." source))
+    (when (probe-file actual) (error "Destinazione esistente: ~A." actual))
+    (ensure-directories-exist actual)
+    (if compressed
+        (let ((decoded (pathname (concatenate 'string (namestring actual) ".decoded"))))
+          (uiop:run-program (list "gzip" "-n" "-9" "-c" (namestring source)) :output actual)
+          (unwind-protect
+               (progn
+                 (uiop:run-program (list "gzip" "-d" "-c" (namestring actual)) :output decoded)
+                 (unless (equal before (native-fingerprint decoded)) (error "Espansione diversa: ~A." source)))
+            (when (probe-file decoded) (delete-file decoded))))
+        (progn (uiop:copy-file source actual)
+               (unless (or *defer-normal-sha* (equal before (fingerprint actual)))
+                 (error "Copia diversa: ~A." source))))
+    (unless (or (and *defer-normal-sha* (not compressed))
+                (equal before (native-fingerprint source))) (error "Sorgente cambiata: ~A." source))
+    ;; For normal deferred files this is an expectation, not an accepted index entry.
+    (let ((stored (if (and *defer-normal-sha* (not compressed)) before (native-fingerprint actual))))
+      (unless (<= (getf stored :bytes) (if (equal "gz" (pathname-type actual)) +gzip-limit+ +plain-limit+))
+        (error "Artefatto oltre budget: ~A." actual))
+      (append (list :path (enough-namestring actual root) :source (namestring source)) stored
+              (when compressed (list :codec :gzip :uncompressed-bytes size
+                                     :uncompressed-sha256 (getf before :sha256)))))))
+
+(defun parallel-map-four (function items)
+  "Ordered results, at most four workers; join all and propagate every failure."
+  (let* ((input (coerce items 'vector)) (size (length input)) (workers (min 4 size))
+         (results (make-array size)) (failures (make-array size :initial-element nil))
+         (threads nil) (launch-failure nil) (join-failures nil)
+         (defaults *default-pathname-defaults*) (package *package*)
+         (stdout *standard-output*) (stderr *error-output*)
+         (source-fingerprints *source-fingerprints*) (defer-normal-sha *defer-normal-sha*))
+    (unwind-protect
+         (handler-case
+             (dotimes (worker workers)
+               (let ((start worker))
+                 (push (sb-thread:make-thread
+                        (lambda ()
+                          (let ((*default-pathname-defaults* defaults) (*package* package)
+                                (*standard-output* stdout) (*error-output* stderr)
+                                (*source-fingerprints* source-fingerprints) (*defer-normal-sha* defer-normal-sha))
+                            (loop for index from start below size by workers do
+                              (handler-case (setf (aref results index) (funcall function (aref input index)))
+                                (serious-condition (condition) (setf (aref failures index) condition))))))
+                        :name (format nil "publication-worker-~D" start)) threads)))
+           (serious-condition (condition) (setf launch-failure condition)))
+      (sb-sys:without-interrupts
+        (dolist (thread threads)
+          (handler-case (sb-thread:join-thread thread)
+            (serious-condition (condition) (push condition join-failures))))))
+    (let ((errors (loop for condition across failures for index from 0 when condition
+                        collect (list index (princ-to-string condition)))))
+      (when (or launch-failure join-failures errors)
+        (error "Parallel publication failed after joining all workers: launch=~A joins=~S entries=~S."
+               launch-failure (mapcar #'princ-to-string join-failures) errors)))
+    (coerce results 'list)))
+
+(defun collect (manifest-path destination)
+  (let* ((manifest (read-one manifest-path))
+         (root (merge-pathnames (uiop:ensure-directory-pathname destination) (truename "./")))
+         (manifest-before (native-fingerprint manifest-path))
+         (collector-before (native-fingerprint *collector-source*))
+         (library (merge-pathnames "batch-sha.lisp" *collector-source*))
+         (library-before (native-fingerprint library))
+         (files nil) (processes nil))
+    (unless (equal *batch-library-sha256* (getf library-before :sha256))
+      (error "Libreria batch diversa dalla fonte preregistrata."))
+    (load library :verbose nil :print nil)
+    (unless (and (eql 1 (getf manifest :schema-version)) (getf manifest :groups))
+      (error "Manifesto invalido."))
+    (when (probe-file root) (error "Archivio esistente: ~A." root))
+    (dolist (group (getf manifest :groups))
+      (destructuring-bind (label source-directory &optional process-p) group
+        (unless (leaf-p label) (error "Nome gruppo invalido."))
+        (let* ((base (truename (uiop:ensure-directory-pathname source-directory)))
+               (target-base (merge-pathnames (format nil "raw/~A/" label) root))
+               (before (files-in base))
+               (source-before (batch-snapshot before))
+               (*source-fingerprints* (snapshot-table source-before))
+               (*defer-normal-sha* t))
+          (unless (equal (mapcar #'namestring before)
+                         (mapcar (lambda (row) (getf row :path)) source-before))
+            (error "Snapshot sorgente non esatto: ~A." label))
+          (when (and process-p (> (getf (fingerprint (merge-pathnames "report.lisp" base)) :bytes)
+                                 +plain-limit+))
+            (error "Il produttore deve compattare il suo report prima della raccolta."))
+          (let* ((targets (mapcar (lambda (file) (merge-pathnames (enough-namestring file base) target-base)) before))
+                 (owned (loop for file in before for target in targets append
+                          (if (and (> (getf (fingerprint file) :bytes) +plain-limit+)
+                                   (not (equal "gz" (pathname-type file))))
+                              (list (concatenate 'string (namestring target) ".gz")
+                                    (concatenate 'string (namestring target) ".gz.decoded"))
+                              (list (namestring target))))))
+            (unless (= (length owned) (length (remove-duplicates owned :test #'equal)))
+              (error "Destinazioni/temp paralleli duplicati: ~A." label))
+            (dolist (name owned) (ensure-directories-exist name))
+            (let* ((pending (parallel-map-four (lambda (pair) (copy-verified (car pair) (cdr pair) root))
+                                              (mapcar #'cons before targets)))
+                   (copy-paths (sort (mapcar (lambda (entry) (merge-pathnames (getf entry :path) root)) pending)
+                                     #'string< :key #'namestring))
+                   (source-after (files-in base)))
+              (unless (and (equal before source-after)
+                           (equal copy-paths (files-in target-base)))
+                (error "Insieme sorgente/copie cambiato dopo join: ~A." label))
+              (let* ((copy-after (batch-snapshot copy-paths))
+                     (source-after-hashes (batch-snapshot source-after))
+                     (copy-table (snapshot-table copy-after)))
+                (unless (and (equal source-before source-after-hashes)
+                             (equal (mapcar #'namestring copy-paths)
+                                    (mapcar (lambda (row) (getf row :path)) copy-after)))
+                  (error "Sorgenti mutate o snapshot copie incompleto: ~A." label))
+                (dolist (entry pending)
+                  (let* ((source (gethash (getf entry :source) *source-fingerprints*))
+                         (copy (gethash (namestring (merge-pathnames (getf entry :path) root)) copy-table))
+                         (compressed (eq :gzip (getf entry :codec))))
+                    (unless (and (equal (row-fingerprint copy) (list :bytes (getf entry :bytes)
+                                                                   :sha256 (getf entry :sha256)))
+                                 (equal (row-fingerprint source)
+                                        (list :bytes (getf entry (if compressed :uncompressed-bytes :bytes))
+                                              :sha256 (getf entry (if compressed :uncompressed-sha256 :sha256)))))
+                      (error "Copia batch diversa dalle aspettative originarie: ~A." (getf entry :source)))))
+                (unless (and (equal before (files-in base)) (equal copy-paths (files-in target-base)))
+                  (error "Inventario sorgente/copie mutato durante hash batch: ~A." label))
+                ;; Only fully verified groups can enter the future archive index.
+                (setf files (nconc pending files)))))
+          (when process-p
+            (let* ((source (merge-pathnames "report.lisp" base))
+                   (target (merge-pathnames "report.lisp" target-base)) (data (read-one source)))
+              (unless (and (eql 1 (getf data :schema-version)) (eq :command-verification (getf data :kind))
+                           (member (getf data :status) '(:ok :failed :source-changed))
+                           (equalp data (read-one target)))
+                (error "Record incompleto o diverso: ~A." source))
+              (push (list :label label :record-path (enough-namestring target root)
+                          :command (getf data :command) :status (getf data :status)
+                          :exit-code (getf data :exit-code) :source-consistency (getf data :source-consistency))
+                    processes))))))
+    ;; Outside group bindings all original per-file checks remain active, as in append.
+    (push (copy-verified (truename manifest-path) (merge-pathnames "collection-manifest.lisp" root) root) files)
+    (push (copy-verified (truename *collector-source*) (merge-pathnames "collection-source.txt" root) root) files)
+    (dolist (item (getf manifest :files))
+      (destructuring-bind (label source) item
+        (unless (leaf-p label) (error "Nome file invalido."))
+        (push (copy-verified (truename source) (merge-pathnames label root) root) files)))
+    (unless (and (equal manifest-before (native-fingerprint manifest-path))
+                 (equal collector-before (native-fingerprint *collector-source*))
+                 (equal library-before (native-fingerprint library)))
+      (error "Manifesto, collector o libreria mutati prima dell'indice finale."))
+    (let ((paths (mapcar (lambda (entry) (getf entry :path)) files)))
+      (unless (= (length paths) (length (remove-duplicates paths :test #'equal))) (error "Path duplicato.")))
+    (save-new (merge-pathnames "archive-index.lisp" root)
+              (list :schema-version 1 :kind :original-command-archive
+                    :metadata-policy :read-without-result-inference :processes (reverse processes)
+                    :files (sort (copy-list files) #'string< :key (lambda (entry) (getf entry :path)))
+                    :limits '(:complete-explicit-groups :raw-fasl-preserved-as-data
+                              :source-and-copy-sha256 :lossless-gzip-for-large-raw :no-result-promotion)))
+    (save-new (merge-pathnames "catalogo.lisp" root)
+              (list :schema-version 1 :kind :evidence-catalog :pending nil :entries
+                    (list (list :kind :original-command-archive :artifact "archive-index.lisp"
+                                :artifact-schema-version 1 :artifact-kind :original-command-archive))))
+    (format t "~D file conservati, ~D comandi.~%" (length files) (length processes))))
+
+(defun append-group (destination label source-directory)
+  "Aggiunge un gruppo completo; riscrive soltanto l'indice derivato, mai originali."
+  (unless (leaf-p label) (error "Nome gruppo invalido."))
+  (let* ((root (truename (uiop:ensure-directory-pathname destination)))
+         (index-path (merge-pathnames "archive-index.lisp" root)) (index (read-one index-path))
+         (base (truename (uiop:ensure-directory-pathname source-directory)))
+         (target-base (merge-pathnames (format nil "raw/~A/" label) root))
+         (source (merge-pathnames "report.lisp" base)) (data (read-one source))
+         (before (files-in base)) (files nil))
+    (when (> (arcdocdb.evidence:file-bytes source) +plain-limit+)
+      (error "Il produttore deve compattare il suo report prima dell'aggiunta."))
+    (when (probe-file target-base) (error "Gruppo esistente."))
+    (unless (and (eq :original-command-archive (getf index :kind))
+                 (eq :command-verification (getf data :kind))
+                 (member (getf data :status) '(:ok :failed :source-changed)))
+      (error "Archivio o comando incompleto."))
+    (dolist (file before)
+      (push (copy-verified file (merge-pathnames (enough-namestring file base) target-base) root) files))
+    (unless (and (equal before (files-in base))
+                 (equalp data (read-one (merge-pathnames "report.lisp" target-base))))
+      (error "Sorgente/record diverso."))
+    (setf (getf index :files) (append (getf index :files) (nreverse files))
+          (getf index :processes)
+          (append (getf index :processes)
+                  (list (list :label label :record-path (enough-namestring
+                                                        (merge-pathnames "report.lisp" target-base) root)
+                              :command (getf data :command) :status (getf data :status)
+                              :exit-code (getf data :exit-code) :source-consistency (getf data :source-consistency)))))
+    (with-open-file (stream index-path :direction :output :if-exists :supersede)
+      (let ((*print-readably* t)) (write index :stream stream :pretty t) (terpri stream)))
+    (format t "Gruppo ~A aggiunto, ~D file.~%" label (length files))))
+
+(defun directory-prefix-p (root path)
+  (uiop:string-prefix-p (namestring (uiop:ensure-directory-pathname root)) (namestring path)))
+
+(defun byte-inventory (root)
+  "Inventario ordinato di path e bytes originali; non interpreta i file."
+  (loop for file in (files-in root)
+        collect (append (list :path (enough-namestring file root)) (fingerprint file))))
+
+(defun size-inventory (root)
+  "I file già archiviati sono censiti per path e dimensione, senza nuovo SHA.
+L'audit finale controlla separatamente tutti i loro hash in due passaggi."
+  (loop for file in (files-in root)
+        collect (list :path (enough-namestring file root)
+                      :bytes (arcdocdb.evidence:file-bytes file))))
+
+(defun append-files (destination label source-directory)
+  "Aggiunge solo bytes di un gruppo completo, senza inferire report o risultati.
+Le copie parziali e gli indici preparatori restano disponibili in caso di errore."
+  (unless (leaf-p label) (error "Nome gruppo invalido."))
+  (let* ((root (truename (uiop:ensure-directory-pathname destination)))
+         (base (truename (uiop:ensure-directory-pathname source-directory)))
+         (index-path (merge-pathnames "archive-index.lisp" root))
+         (index (read-one index-path))
+         (prefix (format nil "raw/~A/" label))
+         (target-base (merge-pathnames prefix root))
+         (helper-base (uiop:pathname-directory-pathname (truename *collector-source*)))
+         (backup (merge-pathnames (format nil "append-~A-index-before.lisp.txt" label) helper-base))
+         (candidate (merge-pathnames (format nil "append-~A-index-next.lisp.txt" label) helper-base))
+         (collector-before (fingerprint *collector-source*))
+         (index-before (fingerprint index-path))
+         (source-before nil) (archive-before nil) (expected-archive nil) (index-next nil) (files nil))
+    (unless (and (eql 1 (getf index :schema-version))
+                 (eq :original-command-archive (getf index :kind))
+                 (eq :read-without-result-inference (getf index :metadata-policy))
+                 (listp (getf index :files)) (getf index :files))
+      (error "Indice archivio invalido."))
+    (when (or (directory-prefix-p root base) (directory-prefix-p base root)

+      (error "Archivio, sorgente e helper devono avere perimetri separati."))
+    (when (or (probe-file target-base)
+              (some (lambda (entry) (uiop:string-prefix-p prefix (getf entry :path)))
+                    (getf index :files))
+              (find label (getf index :processes) :key (lambda (entry) (getf entry :label)) :test #'equal))
+      (error "Gruppo esistente: ~A." label))

+      (error "Prove append esistenti: ~A." label))
+    (setf source-before (byte-inventory base) archive-before (size-inventory root))
+    (unless source-before (error "Gruppo sorgente vuoto: ~A." base))
+    ;; Conserva l'indice precedente fuori dai gruppi e dall'archivio.
+    (uiop:copy-file index-path backup)
+    (unless (equal index-before (fingerprint backup)) (error "Backup indice diverso."))
+    (dolist (entry source-before)
+      (let* ((relative (getf entry :path))
+             (copy (copy-verified (merge-pathnames relative base)
+                                  (merge-pathnames relative target-base) root))
+             (compressed (eq :gzip (getf copy :codec))))
+        (unless (and (= (getf entry :bytes)
+                        (getf copy (if compressed :uncompressed-bytes :bytes)))
+                     (equal (getf entry :sha256)
+                            (getf copy (if compressed :uncompressed-sha256 :sha256))))
+          (error "Copia diversa dall'inventario sorgente iniziale: ~A." relative))
+        (push copy files)))
+    (setf files (sort files #'string< :key (lambda (entry) (getf entry :path))))
+    (unless (and (equal source-before (byte-inventory base))
+                 (equal collector-before (fingerprint *collector-source*)))
+      (error "Gruppo sorgente o collector mutato durante append."))
+    (let* ((new-inventory (mapcar (lambda (entry)
+                                   (list :path (getf entry :path) :bytes (getf entry :bytes))) files))
+           (all-paths (append (mapcar (lambda (entry) (getf entry :path)) (getf index :files))
+                              (mapcar (lambda (entry) (getf entry :path)) files))))
+      (setf expected-archive (sort (append (copy-list archive-before) new-inventory)
+                                  #'string< :key (lambda (entry) (getf entry :path))))
+      (unless (= (length all-paths) (length (remove-duplicates all-paths :test #'equal)))
+        (error "Path indice duplicato."))
+      (unless (equal expected-archive (size-inventory root))
+        (error "Archivio precedente o nuove copie mutati durante append.")))
+    ;; Il gruppo è generico: :processes e tutti gli originali rimangono identici.
+    (setf (getf index :files) (sort (append (copy-list (getf index :files)) files)
+                                  #'string< :key (lambda (entry) (getf entry :path))))
+    (save-new candidate index)
+    (setf index-next (fingerprint candidate))
+    (unless (and (equalp index (read-one candidate))
+                 (equal index-before (fingerprint index-path))
+                 (equal index-before (fingerprint backup))
+                 (equal source-before (byte-inventory base))
+                 (equal collector-before (fingerprint *collector-source*)))
+      (error "Indice preparato o sorgenti mutati prima della pubblicazione."))
+    ;; Rinomina atomica sullo stesso filesystem: un errore conserva il candidato.
+    (sb-posix:rename (namestring candidate) (namestring index-path))
+    (setf expected-archive
+          (mapcar (lambda (entry)
+                    (if (equal "archive-index.lisp" (getf entry :path))
+                        (list :path "archive-index.lisp" :bytes (getf index-next :bytes)) entry)) expected-archive))
+    (unless (and (equalp index (read-one index-path))
+                 (equal index-next (fingerprint index-path))

+    (format t "Limite append: file preesistenti controllati per path/dimensione; SHA completi nell'audit finale.~%")))
+
+(require :sb-posix)
+(let ((arguments (uiop:command-line-arguments)))
+  (cond ((= 2 (length arguments)) (collect (first arguments) (second arguments)))
+        ((and (= 4 (length arguments)) (equal "--append" (first arguments)))
+         (append-group (second arguments) (third arguments) (fourth arguments)))
+        ((and (= 4 (length arguments)) (equal "--append-files" (first arguments)))

+;;;; Static Git-only test inventory. No systems, product or evidence are LOADed.
+;;;; Reuses frozen-suite-summaries/source-token/tree/ASD walking from preflight-local-audit.
+;;;; CLI: --workspace DIR --commit SHA. Output is a single data record.
+(require :asdf)
+(declaim (optimize (safety 3) (debug 3)))
+(defparameter *helper-source* *load-truename*)
+(defparameter *git-cache* (make-hash-table :test #'equal))
+(defun demand (condition control &rest arguments)
+  (unless condition (error (apply #'format nil control arguments))))
+
+(defun git-output (workspace &rest arguments)
+  (let ((key (cons (namestring workspace) arguments)))
+    (or (gethash key *git-cache*)
+        (setf (gethash key *git-cache*)
+              (uiop:run-program (append '("git") arguments) :directory workspace
+                                :output :string :error-output :string)))))
+
+(defun line-output (workspace &rest arguments)
+  (string-right-trim '(#\Newline #\Return) (apply #'git-output workspace arguments)))
+
+
+(defun expected-source-tree (workspace commit)
+  "Require every native source path and blob to equal the explicit Git tree."
+  (let ((entries nil))
+    (dolist (entry (uiop:split-string
+                   (git-output workspace "ls-tree" "-r" "-z" "--full-tree" commit)
+                   :separator '(#\Null)))
+      (when (plusp (length entry))
+        (let* ((tab (position #\Tab entry))
+               (metadata (and tab (uiop:split-string (subseq entry 0 tab) :separator '(#\Space))))
+               (path (and tab (subseq entry (1+ tab)))))
+          (demand (and (= 3 (length metadata)) (string= "blob" (second metadata)) path)
+                  "Unsupported Git tree entry ~S." entry)
+          (unless (uiop:string-prefix-p "spikes/results/" path)
+            (push (list :path path :git-blob (third metadata)) entries)))))
+    (demand entries "Explicit expected source tree is empty.")
+    (sort entries #'string< :key (lambda (entry) (getf entry :path)))))
+
+
+(defun source-token (line prefix)
+  "Extract only the current frozen source's simple token spelling; no Lisp reader."
+  (demand (uiop:string-prefix-p prefix line) "Source prefix mismatch: ~S." line)
+  (let* ((start (length prefix))
+         (end (position-if (lambda (character) (find character " ()")) line :start start))
+         (token (subseq line start (or end (length line)))))
+    (demand (plusp (length token)) "Missing source token: ~S." line)
+    (string-upcase token)))
+
+
+(defun frozen-suite-summaries (options tree)
+  "Derive every suite count/template and ASD execution order from explicit Git source text."
+  (let ((counts (make-hash-table :test #'equal)) (templates (make-hash-table :test #'equal))
+        (names (make-hash-table :test #'equal)) (order nil) (rows nil))
+    (dolist (entry tree)
+      (let ((path (getf entry :path)))
+        (when (and (uiop:string-prefix-p "tests/" path) (uiop:string-suffix-p path ".lisp"))
+          (let ((package nil))
+            (dolist (raw (uiop:split-string
+                          (git-output (getf options :workspace) "show"
+                                      (format nil "~A:~A" (getf options :commit) path))
+                          :separator '(#\Newline)))
+              (let ((line (string-trim '(#\Space #\Tab #\Return) raw)))
+                (when (uiop:string-prefix-p "(in-package #:" line)
+                  (setf package (source-token line "(in-package #:")))
+                (when (uiop:string-prefix-p "(deftest " raw)
+                  (demand package "Test before in-package: ~A." path)
+                  (let ((identity (list package (source-token raw "(deftest "))))
+                    (unless (gethash identity names)
+                      (setf (gethash identity names) t)
+                      (incf (gethash package counts 0)))))
+                (when (uiop:string-prefix-p "(format t \"~D test " line)
+                  (let ((end (position #\" line :start 11)))
+                    (demand (and package end (not (gethash package templates)))
+                            "Missing/duplicate suite template: ~A." path)
+                    (setf (gethash package templates) (subseq line 11 end))))))))))
+    (dolist (line (uiop:split-string
+                  (git-output (getf options :workspace) "show"
+                              (format nil "~A:arcdocdb.asd" (getf options :commit)))
+                  :separator '(#\Newline)))
+      (let ((trimmed (string-trim '(#\Space #\Tab #\Return) line)))
+        (when (uiop:string-prefix-p "(uiop:symbol-call '#:" trimmed)
+          (push (source-token trimmed "(uiop:symbol-call '#:") order))))
+    (setf order (nreverse order))
+    (demand (and (equal "ARCDOCDB.TESTS" (first order))
+                 (= (length order) (1+ (hash-table-count counts)))
+                 (= (length order) (length (remove-duplicates order :test #'equal))))
+            "Frozen ASD suite order/count is inconsistent.")
+    (dolist (package (rest order))
+      (let ((count (gethash package counts)) (template (gethash package templates)))
+        (demand (and count template) "Missing frozen suite count/template for ~A." package)
+        (push (list :package package :count count
+                    :native-line (string-right-trim '(#\Newline #\Return) (format nil template count))) rows)))
+    (setf rows (nreverse rows))
+    (let ((total (reduce #'+ rows :key (lambda (row) (getf row :count)))))
+      (when (getf options :expect-tests)
+        (demand (= (getf options :expect-tests) total) "Frozen test count differs from --expect-tests.")))
+    rows))
+
+
+(defun frozen-test-source-order (options tree)
+  "Adapt the reviewed ASD data walker; preserve serial test component order."
+  (let* ((text (git-output (getf options :workspace) "show"
+                           (format nil "~A:arcdocdb.asd" (getf options :commit))))
+         (systems nil) (files nil))
+    (demand (<= (length text) 1048576) "Frozen ASD source exceeds budget.")
+    (with-standard-io-syntax
+      (let ((*read-eval* nil) (*package* (find-package :asdf-user)) (eof (gensym "EOF")))
+        (with-input-from-string (stream text)
+          (loop for form = (read stream nil eof) until (eq eof form)
+                do (when (and (consp form) (symbolp (first form))
+                              (equal "DEFSYSTEM" (symbol-name (first form)))
+                              (equal "arcdocdb/tests" (second form)))
+                     (push form systems))))))
+    (demand (= 1 (length systems)) "Require exactly one frozen tests ASDF system.")
+    (labels ((leaf-p (name)
+               (and (stringp name) (plusp (length name))
+                    (not (find-if (lambda (c) (find c "/\\:*?[] .")) name))))
+             (walk (components base depth)
+               (demand (and components (listp components) (<= depth 12)) "Frozen ASDF components/depth.")
+               (loop for component in components append
+                 (progn
+                   (demand (and (consp component) (leaf-p (second component))
+                                (null (getf (cddr component) :pathname))
+                                (null (getf (cddr component) :depends-on)))
+                           "Unsupported frozen ASDF component ~S." component)
+                   (ecase (first component)
+                     (:file (list (concatenate 'string base (second component) ".lisp")))
+                     (:module
+                      (demand (eq t (getf (cddr component) :serial)) "Nonserial frozen test module.")
+                      (walk (getf (cddr component) :components)
+                            (concatenate 'string base (second component) "/") (1+ depth))))))))
+      (let* ((system (first systems)) (base (getf (cddr system) :pathname)))
+        (demand (and (equal "tests/" base) (eq t (getf (cddr system) :serial)))
+                "Unsupported frozen tests pathname/serialization.")
+        (setf files (walk (getf (cddr system) :components) base 0))))
+    (demand (and files (<= (length files) 4096)
+                 (= (length files) (length (remove-duplicates files :test #'equal)))
+                 (every (lambda (path) (find path tree :test #'equal :key (lambda (entry) (getf entry :path)))) files))
+            "Frozen ASDF files duplicate or absent from Git source tree.")
+    files))
+
+(defun ordered-suite-names (options files rows)
+  "Literal deftest source tokens only; model the two existing registry macros."
+  (let ((names (make-hash-table :test #'equal)) (policies (make-hash-table :test #'equal))
+        (suite-files (make-hash-table :test #'equal)) (duplicates nil) (smoke nil))
+    (dolist (file files)
+      (let* ((text (git-output (getf options :workspace) "show" (format nil "~A:~A" (getf options :commit) file)))
+             (package nil) (macro (search "(defmacro deftest " text))
+             (end (and macro (search (format nil "~%(def") text :start2 (1+ macro))))
+             (definition (and macro (subseq text macro end))))
+        (demand (<= (length text) 2097152) "Frozen test source budget: ~A." file)
+        (dolist (raw (uiop:split-string text :separator '(#\Newline)))
+          (let ((line (string-trim '(#\Space #\Tab #\Return) raw)))
+            (when (uiop:string-prefix-p "(in-package #:" line)
+              (setf package (source-token line "(in-package #:"))
+              (when definition
+                (let ((policy (cond ((search "pushnew ',name " definition) :first-definition)
+                                    ((and (search "acons ',name #',name" definition)
+                                          (search "remove ',name " definition)) :last-definition))))
+                  (demand (and policy (not (gethash package policies)))
+                          "Unknown/duplicate registry macro: ~A in ~A." package file)
+                  (setf (gethash package policies) policy))))
+            (when (uiop:string-prefix-p "(deftest " raw)
+              (demand (and package (gethash package policies)) "No supported registry before test: ~A." file)
+              (pushnew file (gethash package suite-files) :test #'equal)
+              (let* ((name (source-token raw "(deftest "))
+                     (previous (member name (gethash package names) :test #'equal)))
+                (when previous (push (list :package package :name name :file file) duplicates))
+                (cond ((eq :last-definition (gethash package policies))
+                       (setf (gethash package names)
+                             (append (remove name (gethash package names) :test #'equal) (list name))))
+                      ((not previous)
+                       (setf (gethash package names) (append (gethash package names) (list name)))))))
+            (when (and (equal package "ARCDOCDB.TESTS") (uiop:string-prefix-p "(list (check \"" line))
+              (push (subseq line 14 (position #\" line :start 14)) smoke))
+            (when (and (equal package "ARCDOCDB.TESTS") (uiop:string-prefix-p "(check \"" line))
+              (push (subseq line 8 (position #\" line :start 8)) smoke))))))
+    (demand (= (hash-table-count names) (length rows)) "Registered named suites differ from all frozen source suites.")
+    (dolist (row rows)
+      (let ((package (getf row :package)))
+        (demand (= (getf row :count) (length (gethash package names)))
+                "Serial ASDF registry count differs from frozen source count: ~A." package)
+        (nconc row (list :test-names (gethash package names)
+                         :test-source-files (reverse (gethash package suite-files))
+                         :duplicate-policy (gethash package policies)))))
+    (values rows (nreverse duplicates) (nreverse smoke))))
+
+(defun options ()
+  (let ((args (uiop:command-line-arguments)) (workspace nil) (commit nil))
+    (loop while args for key = (pop args) do
+      (demand args "Missing option value.")
+      (cond ((equal "--workspace" key) (demand (null workspace) "Duplicate workspace.") (setf workspace (pop args)))
+            ((equal "--commit" key) (demand (null commit) "Duplicate commit.") (setf commit (pop args)))
+            (t (demand nil "Unknown option: ~A." key))))
+    (demand (and workspace commit) "Usage --workspace DIR --commit SHA.")
+    (setf workspace (truename (uiop:ensure-directory-pathname workspace)))
+    (let ((resolved (line-output workspace "rev-parse" "--verify" (concatenate 'string commit "^{commit}"))))
+      (demand (and (= 40 (length resolved)) (every (lambda (c) (digit-char-p c 16)) resolved)) "Commit SHA shape.")
+      (list :workspace workspace :commit resolved))))
+
+(handler-case
+    (let* ((options (options)) (workspace (getf options :workspace)) (commit (getf options :commit))
+           (tree (expected-source-tree workspace commit))
+           (rows (frozen-suite-summaries options tree))
+           (files (frozen-test-source-order options tree)))
+      (multiple-value-bind (named duplicates smoke) (ordered-suite-names options files rows)
+        (let ((record (list :schema-version 1 :kind :frozen-git-test-inventory :status :ok
+                            :workspace (namestring workspace) :commit commit
+                            :git-tree (line-output workspace "rev-parse" (concatenate 'string commit "^{tree}"))
+                            :module-test-total (reduce #'+ named :key (lambda (row) (getf row :count)))
+                            :named-suite-count (length named) :smoke-check-names smoke :smoke-count (length smoke)
+                            :suite-execution-order (mapcar (lambda (row) (getf row :package)) named)
+                            :serial-test-source-files files :suites named :duplicate-definitions duplicates
+                            :limits '(:static-literal-source-tokens :asd-read-eval-disabled
+                                      :serial-asdf-components-only :two-existing-registry-macro-shapes
+                                      :no-source-evaluation :no-systems-loaded :no-evidence-loaded :no-tests-executed))))
+          (let ((*print-readably* t) (*print-length* nil) (*print-level* nil)) (write record :pretty t) (terpri)))))
+  (error (condition)
+    (let ((*print-readably* t))
+      (write (list :schema-version 1 :kind :frozen-git-test-inventory :status :failed
+                   :diagnostic (princ-to-string condition)) :pretty t) (terpri))
+    (sb-ext:exit :code 1)))

+;;;; Read-only audit of downloaded CI artifacts against an explicit Git commit.
+;;;; Only the trusted evidence reader is LOADed; all reports/logs are data.
+;;;; Invoke SBCL with --dynamic-space-size 2048. No tracked files are changed.
+;;;; GET source lifetime derivative; original SHA256:
+;;;; 08ff4de3ac096819c0deed99594ffa2cecb34cc53ec86a24424a4d73e4c93bdf
+;;;; Only DIRECTORY named-order checks and report attribution extend the original audit.
+(require :asdf)
+(require :sb-posix)
+(declaim (optimize (safety 3) (debug 3)))
+(defparameter *auditor-source* *load-truename*)
+
+(define-condition ci-audit-error (error)
+  ((message :initarg :message :reader audit-message))
+  (:report (lambda (condition stream) (write-string (audit-message condition) stream))))
+
+(defun demand (condition control &rest arguments)
+  (unless condition
+    (error 'ci-audit-error :message (apply #'format nil control arguments))))
+
+(defun read-native (path)
+  (uiop:symbol-call :arcdocdb.evidence :read-evidence path))
+
+(defun native-sha256 (path)
+  (uiop:symbol-call :arcdocdb.evidence :file-sha256 path))
+
+(defun parse-options (arguments)
+  (let ((workspace nil) (commit nil) (run nil) (tests nil)
+        (epochs 34) (read-tests 30) (get-tests nil) (resolver-tests nil) (active-tests nil)
+        (smoke 2) (platforms nil) (all nil))
+    (labels ((argument ()
+               (demand arguments "Missing option argument.") (pop arguments))
+             (number-argument ()
+               (let ((value (parse-integer (argument) :junk-allowed nil)))
+                 (demand (plusp value) "Counts/run must be positive integers.") value)))
+      (loop while arguments for option = (pop arguments) do
+        (cond ((string= option "--workspace")
+               (demand (null workspace) "Duplicate --workspace.") (setf workspace (argument)))
+              ((string= option "--commit")
+               (demand (null commit) "Duplicate --commit.") (setf commit (argument)))
+              ((string= option "--run")
+               (demand (null run) "Duplicate --run.") (setf run (number-argument)))
+              ((string= option "--tests")
+               (demand (null tests) "Duplicate --tests.") (setf tests (number-argument)))
+              ((string= option "--epochs") (setf epochs (number-argument)))
+              ((string= option "--read") (setf read-tests (number-argument)))
+              ((string= option "--get") (setf get-tests (number-argument)))
+              ((string= option "--resolver") (setf resolver-tests (number-argument)))
+              ((string= option "--active")
+               (demand (null active-tests) "Duplicate --active.")
+               (setf active-tests (number-argument)))
+              ((string= option "--smoke") (setf smoke (number-argument)))
+              ((string= option "--require-all-platforms") (setf all t))
+              ((string= option "--platform")
+               (let ((label (argument)) (directory (argument)))
+                 (push (list label directory) platforms)))
+              (t (demand nil "Unknown option ~S." option)))))
+    (demand (and workspace commit run tests get-tests resolver-tests active-tests platforms)
+            "Usage: --workspace DIR --commit SHA --run ID --tests N --get N --resolver N --active 42 [--epochs 34 --read 30 --smoke 2] [--require-all-platforms] --platform LABEL DIR [...]")
+    (demand (= 42 active-tests) "This campaign requires --active 42.")
+    (list :workspace (truename (uiop:ensure-directory-pathname workspace))
+          :commit commit :run run :tests tests :epochs epochs :read read-tests
+          :get get-tests :resolver resolver-tests :active active-tests :smoke smoke
+          :all-platforms all :platforms (nreverse platforms))))
+
+(defun git-output (workspace &rest arguments)
+  (uiop:run-program (append '("git") arguments) :directory workspace
+                    :output :string :error-output :string))
+
+(defun line-output (workspace &rest arguments)
+  (string-right-trim '(#\Newline #\Return) (apply #'git-output workspace arguments)))
+
+(defun expected-source-tree (workspace commit)
+  "Require every native source path and blob to equal the explicit Git tree."
+  (let ((entries nil))
+    (dolist (entry (uiop:split-string
+                   (git-output workspace "ls-tree" "-r" "-z" "--full-tree" commit)
+                   :separator '(#\Null)))
+      (when (plusp (length entry))
+        (let* ((tab (position #\Tab entry))
+               (metadata (and tab (uiop:split-string (subseq entry 0 tab) :separator '(#\Space))))
+               (path (and tab (subseq entry (1+ tab)))))
+          (demand (and (= 3 (length metadata)) (string= "blob" (second metadata)) path)
+                  "Unsupported Git tree entry ~S." entry)
+          (unless (uiop:string-prefix-p "spikes/results/" path)
+            (push (list :path path :git-blob (third metadata)) entries)))))
+    (demand entries "Explicit expected source tree is empty.")
+    (sort entries #'string< :key (lambda (entry) (getf entry :path)))))
+
+(defun canonical-platform (label)
+  (setf label (string-downcase label))
+  (cond ((member label '("ubuntu" "ubuntu-latest") :test #'string=) :ubuntu)
+        ((member label '("macos" "macos-latest") :test #'string=) :macos)
+        ((member label '("documentazione" "docs") :test #'string=) :documentazione)
+        (t (demand nil "Unknown platform label ~S." label))))
+
+(defun walk-files (directory)
+  "Inventory all regular files, including hidden files; reject symlinks/special files."
+  (let ((files nil) (count 0))
+    (labels ((walk (base depth)
+               (demand (<= depth 128) "Artifact directory depth exceeds limit.")
+               (dolist (path (directory (make-pathname :name :wild :type :wild :defaults base)
+                                        :resolve-symlinks nil))
+                 (demand (<= (incf count) 100000) "Artifact inventory exceeds entry limit.")
+                 (let ((mode (sb-posix:stat-mode (sb-posix:lstat (string-right-trim "/" (namestring path))))))
+                   (cond ((sb-posix:s-isdir mode) (walk (uiop:ensure-directory-pathname path) (1+ depth)))
+                         ((sb-posix:s-isreg mode) (push path files))
+                         (t (demand nil "Artifact contains a symlink or special file: ~A." path)))))))
+      (walk directory 0))
+    (sort files #'string< :key #'namestring)))
+
+(defun byte-inventory (directory)
+  "Capture raw downloaded bytes without decoding, executing, or modifying them."
+  (loop for path in (walk-files directory)
+        collect (list :path (enough-namestring path directory)
+                      :bytes (uiop:symbol-call :arcdocdb.evidence :file-bytes path)
+                      :sha256 (native-sha256 path))))
+
+(defun source-token (line prefix)
+  "Extract only the current frozen source's simple token spelling; no Lisp reader."
+  (demand (uiop:string-prefix-p prefix line) "Source prefix mismatch: ~S." line)
+  (let* ((start (length prefix))
+         (end (position-if (lambda (character) (find character " ()")) line :start start))
+         (token (subseq line start (or end (length line)))))
+    (demand (plusp (length token)) "Missing source token: ~S." line)
+    (string-upcase token)))
+
+(defun frozen-test-names (options files)
+  (loop for file in files append
+        (loop for line in (uiop:split-string
+                          (git-output (getf options :workspace) "show"
+                                      (format nil "~A:~A" (getf options :commit) file))
+                          :separator '(#\Newline))
+              when (uiop:string-prefix-p "(deftest " line)
+                collect (format nil "ok    ~A" (source-token line "(deftest ")))))
+
+(defun frozen-suite-summaries (options tree)
+  "Derive every suite count/template and ASD execution order from explicit Git source text."
+  (let ((counts (make-hash-table :test #'equal)) (templates (make-hash-table :test #'equal))
+        (names (make-hash-table :test #'equal)) (order nil) (rows nil))
+    (dolist (entry tree)
+      (let ((path (getf entry :path)))
+        (when (and (uiop:string-prefix-p "tests/" path) (uiop:string-suffix-p path ".lisp"))
+          (let ((package nil))
+            (dolist (raw (uiop:split-string
+                          (git-output (getf options :workspace) "show"
+                                      (format nil "~A:~A" (getf options :commit) path))
+                          :separator '(#\Newline)))
+              (let ((line (string-trim '(#\Space #\Tab #\Return) raw)))
+                (when (uiop:string-prefix-p "(in-package #:" line)
+                  (setf package (source-token line "(in-package #:")))
+                (when (uiop:string-prefix-p "(deftest " raw)
+                  (demand package "Test before in-package: ~A." path)
+                  (let ((identity (list package (source-token raw "(deftest "))))
+                    (unless (gethash identity names)
+                      (setf (gethash identity names) t)
+                      (incf (gethash package counts 0)))))
+                (when (uiop:string-prefix-p "(format t \"~D test " line)
+                  (let ((end (position #\" line :start 11)))
+                    (demand (and package end (not (gethash package templates)))
+                            "Missing/duplicate suite template: ~A." path)
+                    (setf (gethash package templates) (subseq line 11 end))))))))))
+    (dolist (line (uiop:split-string
+                  (git-output (getf options :workspace) "show"
+                              (format nil "~A:arcdocdb.asd" (getf options :commit)))
+                  :separator '(#\Newline)))
+      (let ((trimmed (string-trim '(#\Space #\Tab #\Return) line)))
+        (when (uiop:string-prefix-p "(uiop:symbol-call '#:" trimmed)
+          (push (source-token trimmed "(uiop:symbol-call '#:") order))))
+    (setf order (nreverse order))
+    (demand (and (equal "ARCDOCDB.TESTS" (first order))
+                 (= (length order) (1+ (hash-table-count counts)))
+                 (= (length order) (length (remove-duplicates order :test #'equal))))
+            "Frozen ASD suite order/count is inconsistent.")
+    (dolist (package (rest order))
+      (let ((count (gethash package counts)) (template (gethash package templates)))
+        (demand (and count template) "Missing frozen suite count/template for ~A." package)
+        (push (list :package package :count count
+                    :native-line (string-right-trim '(#\Newline #\Return) (format nil template count))) rows)))
+    (setf rows (nreverse rows))
+    (demand (= (getf options :tests) (reduce #'+ rows :key (lambda (row) (getf row :count))))
+            "Frozen source test count differs from --tests.")
+    rows))

+(defun native-record-path-p (path)
+  "Ignore large SPK aggregate reports; they are outside this audit's scope."
+  (let* ((base (uiop:pathname-directory-pathname path))
+         (parts (pathname-directory base)) (parent (car (last parts))))
+    (and (string= "report.lisp" (file-namestring path))
+         (stringp parent)
+         (or (search "-command-" parent) (search "-reader-self-test-" parent)
+             (search "-snapshot-self-test-" parent)))))
+
+(defun frozen-directory-suite (options)
+  "Derive DIRECTORY count/summary from the frozen suite row; identities follow its serial ASD files."
+  (let* ((row (find "ARCDOCDB.GET.DIRECTORY.TESTS" (getf options :suite-summaries)
+                    :key (lambda (entry) (getf entry :package)) :test #'equal))
+         (count (getf row :count)) (summary (getf row :native-line))
+         (names (frozen-test-names options '("tests/get-directory/construction.lisp"
+                                            "tests/get-directory/read.lisp"
+                                            "tests/get-directory/threads.lisp"
+                                            "tests/get-directory/series-read.lisp"
+                                            "tests/get-directory/lifetime.lisp"))))
+    (demand (and (typep count '(integer 1)) (stringp summary)
+                 (= count (length names))
+                 (= count (length (remove-duplicates names :test #'equal))))
+            "Frozen DIRECTORY names/count/summary are absent or inconsistent.")
+    (setf (getf options :directory-count) count
+          (getf options :directory-summary) summary
+          (getf options :directory-names) names))
+  options)
+
+(defun module-result-lines (stdout)
+  (loop for raw in (uiop:split-string stdout :separator '(#\Newline))
+        for line = (string-trim '(#\Space #\Tab #\Return) raw)
+        when (and (search " test " line) (uiop:string-suffix-p line "superati."))
+          collect line))
+
+(defun audit-named-suite (stdout-lines summary expected-names expected-count)
+  "Compare native printed test identities and their order against frozen serial sources."
+  (demand (= 1 (count summary stdout-lines :test #'equal)) "Missing/duplicate suite summary ~S." summary)
+  (let* ((end (position summary stdout-lines :test #'equal))
+         (prior (position-if (lambda (line) (and (search " test " line)
+                                               (uiop:string-suffix-p line "superati.")))
+                             stdout-lines :end end :from-end t)))
+    (demand prior "No previous suite summary delimiting ~S." summary)
+    (let ((actual (remove-if-not (lambda (line) (uiop:string-prefix-p "ok    " line))
+                                (subseq stdout-lines (1+ prior) end))))
+      (demand (and (= expected-count (length expected-names)) (= expected-count (length actual))
+                   (= expected-count (length (remove-duplicates expected-names :test #'equal)))
+                   (equal actual expected-names))
+              "Named suite identities/count/order differ from frozen source: ~S." summary)
+      (list :native-summary summary :named-tests expected-count
+            :frozen-names-and-order-match t :native-test-names actual))))
+
+(defun audit-test-output (stdout options)
+  (let* ((lines (module-result-lines stdout))
+         (rows (loop for line in lines collect
+                     (let ((count (parse-integer line :junk-allowed t)))
+                       (demand (and count (plusp count)) "Malformed test result ~S." line)
+                       (list :count count :native-line line))))
+         (count (reduce #'+ rows :key (lambda (row) (getf row :count)) :initial-value 0))
+         (expected-epochs (format nil "~D test epoche/reclaim superati." (getf options :epochs)))
+         (expected-read (format nil "~D test dei compiti di lettura superati." (getf options :read)))
+         (expected-get (format nil "~D test GET superati." (getf options :get)))
+         (expected-resolver (format nil "~D test resolver GET superati." (getf options :resolver)))
+         (expected-active (format nil "~D test GET ACTIVE superati." (getf options :active)))
+         (expected-directory (getf options :directory-summary))
+         (smoke-lines '("ok    package ARCDOCDB presente" "ok    ARCDOCDB:*VERSION* è una stringa"))
+         (stdout-lines (loop for line in (uiop:split-string stdout :separator '(#\Newline))
+                             collect (string-trim '(#\Space #\Tab #\Return) line))))
+    (demand (= count (getf options :tests)) "Native module count ~D differs from expected ~D." count (getf options :tests))
+    (demand (equal lines (mapcar (lambda (row) (getf row :native-line)) (getf options :suite-summaries)))
+            "Native suite summary counts/names/order differ from every frozen Git suite.")
+    (demand (= 1 (count expected-epochs lines :test #'string=)) "Missing/duplicate epochs result ~S." expected-epochs)
+    (demand (= 1 (count expected-read lines :test #'string=)) "Missing/duplicate read result ~S." expected-read)
+    (dolist (expected smoke-lines)
+      (demand (= 1 (count expected stdout-lines :test #'string=)) "Missing/duplicate smoke result ~S." expected))
+    (demand (= (length smoke-lines) (getf options :smoke)) "Smoke expected count is inconsistent with the two canonical checks.")
+    (list :module-tests count :epochs-tests (getf options :epochs) :read-tests (getf options :read)
+          :get-tests (getf options :get) :resolver-tests (getf options :resolver)
+          :active-tests (getf options :active) :directory-tests (getf options :directory-count)
+          :smoke-checks (length smoke-lines) :all-frozen-suite-summaries-match t
+          :native-module-result-lines rows
+          :get-names (audit-named-suite stdout-lines expected-get
+                                       (getf options :get-names) (getf options :get))
+          :resolver-names (audit-named-suite stdout-lines expected-resolver
+                                            (getf options :resolver-names) (getf options :resolver))
+          :active-names (audit-named-suite stdout-lines expected-active
+                                          (getf options :active-names) (getf options :active))
+          :directory-names (audit-named-suite stdout-lines expected-directory
+                                              (getf options :directory-names)
+                                              (getf options :directory-count)))))

+(defun audit-process-fixture (pair kind child-kind)
+  (let* ((path (car pair)) (record (cdr pair))
+         (directory (uiop:pathname-directory-pathname path))
+         (mutants (getf record :mutants)) (observations nil))
+    (demand (and (eql 1 (getf record :schema-version)) (eq kind (getf record :kind))
+                 (eq :passed (getf record :status)) (= 2 (getf record :worker-errors))
+                 (null (getf record :baseline)) (= 2 (length mutants)))
+            "Process fixture header/counters invalid: ~A." path)
+    (demand (and (= 1 (count :signal mutants :key (lambda (entry) (getf entry :name))))
+                 (= 1 (count :completion-exit mutants :key (lambda (entry) (getf entry :name)))))
+            "Process fixture names missing/duplicated: ~A." path)
+    (dolist (entry mutants)
+      (let* ((name (getf entry :name)) (execution (getf entry :execution))
+             (report (getf execution :report))
+             (child (merge-pathnames (format nil "~(~A~)/" name) directory))
+             (stdout (merge-pathnames "stdout.log" child))
+             (stderr (merge-pathnames "stderr.log" child))
+             (runner (merge-pathnames "isolated-build.lisp" child)))
+        (demand (and (eq :worker-error (getf entry :result)) (null (getf execution :timed-out))
+                     (eql 1 (getf report :schema-version)) (eq child-kind (getf report :kind)))
+                "Process classification/schema invalid: ~A ~S." path name)
+        (demand (equal (getf execution :argv)
+                       '("sbcl" "--noinform" "--no-userinit" "--no-sysinit" "--disable-debugger" "--script" "isolated-build.lisp"))
+                "Unexpected child argv: ~A ~S." path name)
+        (dolist (file (list stdout stderr runner))
+          (demand (probe-file file) "Missing native process diagnostic ~A." file))
+        (dolist (field '(:runner :stdout-log :stderr-log))
+          (let* ((native (getf execution field))
+                 (leaf (ecase field (:runner "isolated-build.lisp") (:stdout-log "stdout.log") (:stderr-log "stderr.log")))
+                 (suffix (format nil "/~(~A~)/~A" name leaf)))
+            (demand (and (stringp native) (uiop:string-suffix-p native suffix))
+                    "Native process path suffix invalid: ~A ~S." path field)))
+        (demand (equal report (read-native stdout))
+                "Raw child stdout differs from embedded native report: ~A." stdout)
+        (ecase name
+          (:signal
+           (demand (and (eql 9 (getf execution :signal)) (eql 137 (getf execution :exit-code))
+                        (eq :failed (getf report :status)) (eq :tests (getf report :phase))
+                        (eq :runtime (getf report :failure-kind)) (equal "fixture" (getf report :failed-test)))
+                   "SIGKILL fixture OS/runtime values invalid: ~A." path))
+          (:completion-exit
+           (demand (and (null (getf execution :signal)) (eql 7 (getf execution :exit-code))
+                        (eq :ok (getf report :status)) (eq :complete (getf report :phase))
+                        (equal '("fixture") (getf report :passed-tests)))
+                   "Post-COMPLETE nonzero exit values invalid: ~A." path)))
+        (push (list :name name :classification :worker-error :native-signal (getf execution :signal)
+                    :native-exit-code (getf execution :exit-code) :timed-out nil
+                    :raw-stdout-equals-native-report t :raw-stdout-sha256 (native-sha256 stdout)
+                    :raw-stderr-sha256 (native-sha256 stderr)
+                    :raw-runner-sha256 (native-sha256 runner)) observations)))
+    (list :native-process-report (namestring path) :kind kind :status :passed
+          :worker-errors 2 :processes (nreverse observations))))
+
+(defun audit-platform (directory label options expected-tree)

+        (before-inventory (byte-inventory directory))

+    (dolist (path (walk-files directory))
+      (when (native-record-path-p path)
+        (let ((record (read-native path)))
+          (case (getf record :kind)
+            (:command-verification (push (cons path record) parents))
+            (:reader-process-self-test (push (cons path record) reader-fixtures))
+            (:snapshot-process-self-test (push (cons path record) snapshot-fixtures))
+            (otherwise (demand nil "Unexpected native record kind at ~A." path))))))
+    (demand (= 1 (length parents)) "Platform ~A has ~D native command parents; exactly one required." label (length parents))
+    (let* ((pair (first parents)) (path (car pair)) (record (cdr pair))
+           (before (getf record :source-blobs-before)) (after (getf record :source-blobs-after))
+           (sorted (sort (copy-list before) #'string< :key (lambda (entry) (getf entry :path))))
+           (stdout (getf record :stdout)) (command (getf record :command))
+           (environment (getf record :environment)) (native-os (getf environment :os))
+           (native-commit (getf environment :commit))
+           (tests nil) (fixtures nil))
+      (demand (and (eql 1 (getf record :schema-version)) (eq :ok (getf record :status))
+                   (eql 0 (getf record :exit-code)) (eq :stable (getf record :source-consistency))
+                   (equal before after) (equal sorted expected-tree))
+              "Platform ~A native status/source/full tree comparison failed: ~A." label path)
+      (demand (and (stringp stdout) (stringp native-os)) "Native command output/OS absent: ~A." path)
+      (demand (and (stringp (getf record :stderr))
+                   (stringp (getf environment :working-tree))
+                   (zerop (length (string-trim '(#\Space #\Tab #\Newline #\Return)
+                                               (getf environment :working-tree))))
+                   (stringp (getf environment :cwd))
+                   (uiop:absolute-pathname-p (pathname (getf environment :cwd)))
+                   (typep (getf record :started-at-universal-time) '(integer 1))
+                   (typep (getf record :finished-at-universal-time) '(integer 1))
+                   (<= (getf record :started-at-universal-time) (getf record :finished-at-universal-time))
+                   (stringp native-commit) (= 40 (length native-commit))
+                   (every (lambda (character) (digit-char-p character 16)) native-commit))
+              "Native parent identity/clean state/terminal timestamps invalid: ~A." path)
+      (demand (string= (getf options :git-tree)
+                       (line-output (getf options :workspace) "rev-parse" "--verify"
+                                    (concatenate 'string native-commit "^{tree}")))
+              "Native complete Git checkout tree differs from published expected head: ~A." path)
+      (demand (if (eq platform :macos) (search "Darwin" native-os) (search "Linux" native-os))
+              "Platform label ~A contradicts native OS ~S." label native-os)
+      (demand (and command (member (file-namestring (first command)) '("make" "gmake") :test #'string=))
+              "Unexpected recorded command ~S." command)
+      (if (eq platform :documentazione)
+          (progn
+            (demand (equal '("trace" "links") (rest command)) "Documentation command is not make trace links.")
+            (demand (and (null reader-fixtures) (null snapshot-fixtures) (null (module-result-lines stdout)))
+                    "Unexpected test/process output in documentation artifact.")
+            (setf tests (list :module-tests 0 :smoke-checks 0)))
+          (progn
+            (demand (equal '("check-core") (rest command)) "Core command is not make check-core.")
+            (setf tests (audit-test-output stdout options))
+            (demand (and (= 1 (length reader-fixtures)) (= 1 (length snapshot-fixtures)))
+                    "Platform ~A requires exactly one reader and one snapshot process fixture." label)

+      (let ((after-inventory (byte-inventory directory)))
+        (demand (equal before-inventory after-inventory)
+                "Raw downloaded artifact byte inventory changed during audit: ~A." directory))
+      (append
+       (list :platform platform :native-parent (namestring path) :status :ok :native-exit 0
+             :native-parent-stored-sha256 (native-sha256 path)

+             :native-working-tree-clean t :native-command-argv command
+             :complete-checkout-tree-equals-published-head t :native-checkout-tree (getf options :git-tree)
+             :source-blobs (length before) :full-source-path-set-and-blobs-match-explicit-commit t
+             :source-consistency :stable :process-fixtures fixtures
+             :downloaded-byte-inventory-passes 2 :downloaded-byte-inventory-stable t
+             :downloaded-byte-files (length before-inventory)
+             :downloaded-byte-total (reduce #'+ before-inventory :key (lambda (entry) (getf entry :bytes)) :initial-value 0)
+             :downloaded-byte-inventory before-inventory)
+       tests))))
